descriptions.fr: Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products est le spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution d'énergie de renommée mondiale. L'unité de service est responsable du support après-vente mondial des systèmes de protection des générateurs (GCB) et des systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse (SIG), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, la maintenance planifiée, les services supplémentaires, le dépannage, les extensions, les conversions et les échanges. Le service est la clé du succès. En tant que collègue de notre équipe de service mondiale, vous apprécierez le travail indépendant, varié et axé sur la solution. Après une formation polyvalente et pratique en Suisse et à l'étranger, vous dirigerez les installations et l'entretien dans le monde entier. Un endroit techniquement difficile vous attend dans un environnement multiculturel. Cela vous permet de gérer des sites de construction multiculturels dans le monde entier pour des systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse pour le niveau de tension de 110KV – 550KV Responsable de l'exécution réussie de l'installation, de l'entretien et des réparations sur place tout en respectant les dates contractuelles et en tenant compte des exigences juridiques locales Responsable de la qualité des travaux effectués sur place au moyen du contrôle de la qualité et de l'évaluation des capacités du personnel d'aide local qui assure la formation des produits sur place au produit et pendant l'installation Efficacité et orientation des travailleurs Contrôle des coûts des ressources utilisées et rapports réguliers à la gestion du projet Coopération active en matière d'amélioration des processus et intervention proactive des mesures visant à accroître l'efficacité sur le site Vos antécédents Enseignement complet dans la construction métallique, l'industrie électrique ou automobile Les connaissances de base en génie électrique sont un must, formation électrotechnique d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les zones de montage et de mise en service High German et de bonnes compétences en anglais • Tâches avec beaucoup d'espace de conception Possibilités attrayantes pour l'éducation et le développement personnel Activités intéressantes et diverses / projets – aussi avec des affectations étrangères Équipe intégrée et dynamique Culture d'entreprise ouverte Paquet de performance attrayant incluant la rémunération fixe, les frais de voyage et de restauration ainsi que la participation au choix de l'hébergement

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) e contribuire a prodotti che modellano l'affidabilità e le prestazioni della generazione di energia in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo, guiderai e supporterai un team motivato di progettisti CAD, collaborando a stretto contatto con ingegneri esperti, fornitori di progetti e la fabbrica di Oerlikon situata in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dai concetti di progettazione precoce alle iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Avrete la possibilità di avere un impatto reale guidando pratiche di design di alta qualità, promuovendo metodi di lavoro unificati, e la valorizzazione del processo e dell'eccellenza della documentazione. Attraverso un programma di introduzione strutturato, si otterrà l'indipendenza e la fiducia necessaria per guidare il vostro team in modo efficace, mentre beneficiando di mirate opportunità di formazione e sviluppo che supportano la vostra crescita professionale. Come farete un impatto Coach e guidare un team di progettisti CAD, assicurando la creazione, la modifica e la manutenzione di dati di ingegneria per i sistemi e i componenti del circuito-breaker generatore (dimensioni del team ca. 10 FTE) Sviluppare\/enhance\/mantenere i dati master di tutti i prodotti GCB con modelli 3D, disegni e bollette di materiali nei sistemi CAD\/PLM Esecuzione di progetti speciali, progetti di risparmio di costi e miglioramento della qualità dei prodotti Iniziare e stabilire miglioramenti del processo di progettazione Garantire una collaborazione efficiente con altre funzioni ingegneristiche, project lead e ulteriori stakeholder Contribuire alla supervisione e formazione dell' appre insieme ai consulenti di conformità del team Assponsponsabile del team Solida fondazione tecnica come senior designer o equivalente background ingegneristico Esperienza comprovata e gestione sicura degli strumenti CAD (preferibilmente Creo) Forte conoscenza di lavoro dei sistemi PLM (preferibilmente PTC Windchill), ruoli, gestione degli oggetti e processi di rilascio Esperienza in una funzione leader del team o come project manager di un team di progetto Distinguere competenze di auto-organizzazione, così come preciso, stile di lavoro indipendente Capacità di gestire la qualità, priorità temi e affidabilità.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

descriptions.it: The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. Deep understanding of data, analytics, AI\/GenAI technologies, machine learning and analytics platforms. Strong analytical skills to tackle complex data and\/or AI challenges. Awareness of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Ability to bridge strategy, governance, and execution.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Sustainability starts at the design table—and this role puts you right at the center of that impact. As the Engineering Design Sustainability Lead , you will shape how sustainability is embedded into global engineering decisions across our transformer business. This is a highly visible, strategic role where engineering excellence meets environmental responsibility. You will lead the shift from downstream sustainability activities to design‑led outcomes, ensuring product‑level carbon reduction, material optimization, and environmental performance are built into every design choice from the outset. You will work across global engineering teams to translate sustainability ambitions into measurable, auditable product outcomes—balancing cost, safety, quality, and performance. With increasing expectations from customers, regulators, and stakeholders for credible product‑level data, your work will directly support compliance, ESG reporting, and long‑term business resilience. If you thrive at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability—and enjoy influencing without direct authority—this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainable product design at scale. How you'll make an impact Define and drive a global, design‑led sustainability strategy within Engineering. Embed sustainability into engineering standards, processes, and decision frameworks. Reduce product‑level carbon footprint through smart design, material, and architecture choices. Establish sustainability targets, KPIs, and traceable product‑level data at BOM level. Partner across engineering, R&D, supply chain, digital and operations teams globally. Strengthen governance, reporting, and audit‑ready sustainability metrics. Build capability and foster ownership of sustainable design within engineering teams. Translate regulatory and customer sustainability expectations into engineering requirements. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or a closely related sustainability discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in sustainability‑focused roles. Proven success delivering design‑led sustainability or product carbon reduction initiatives. Strong knowledge of lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and carbon accounting. Experience leading global, cross‑functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making. More about us At Hitachi Energy , sustainability, innovation, and safety are core to how we design the future of energy. You'll work in a global, diverse environment where ideas are valued and impact is visible. • We offer meaningful opportunities to grow, lead, and shape industry‑leading solutions with purpose.

descriptions.it: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. B. descriptions.it: Join Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business as our Global Head of Sales. You will lead a global team driving commercial strategy and sales execution across a portfolio that includes enterprise software, automation and communications, power conversion solutions and services. This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of our global go-to-market transformation (Suisen)—focused on customer connection, agility, empowerment, and commercial excellence. You will work across product lines and regions to align diverse sales teams and deliver growth, while shaping how we serve customers in a rapidly evolving energy landscape. The location of this role is flexible globally and will be determined in subsequent stages. How You'll Make an Impact Lead global sales performance across all Grid Automation offerings. Manage a small central team of industry leaders and functional experts focused on global sales strategy and governance. Provide dotted-line leadership to sales leaders in global product groups and regional hubs. Align multiple sales operating models under a unified go-to-market strategy. Drive forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and deal governance. Champion customer-first sales execution and strategic account leadership. Accelerate growth in software, digital, and lifecycle-based offerings. Expand reach through partner ecosystems and channel programs. Collaborate with regional, product, and functional leaders to ensure execution. Lead through transformation, simplifying structures and empowering teams. Your Background 15+ years in global sales leadership roles in energy, software, or industrial sectors. Proven success managing complex, matrixed sales organizations. Experience leading sales transformation or go-to-market redesigns. Strong commercial acumen and forecasting discipline. Familiarity with enterprise software, automation, and power systems. Executive presence and ability to influence across functions and geographies. Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

descriptions.it: Descrizione L'opportunità per la nostra Business Unit Prodotti ad alta tensione a Zurigo-Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un ingegnere R&D per rafforzare il nostro team per lo sviluppo di Interruttori ad alta tensione. Se siete appassionati di risolvere problemi multi-fisici altamente complessi e volete lavorare con gli esperti leader del mondo per sviluppare i circuiti di alta tensione di alta classe, questa è la vostra occasione. Unisciti al nostro team innovativo e fai parte di un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Eseguire attività ingegneristiche relative allo sviluppo di prodotti per progetti specifici R&D dal concept all'implementazione di serie, assicurando l'allineamento tecnico con esperti e stakeholder di progetto - Sostenere il Design Lead negli argomenti di sviluppo del prodotto e garantire la documentazione strutturata delle attività di sviluppo - Pianificare e supervisionare il montaggio, lo smontaggio e l'ispezione dei prototipi insieme ad altri esperti - Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle attività R&D Il tuo sfondo - Laurea magistrale in ingegneria meccanica o un soggetto strettamente correlato da un'università politecnica/tecnica - L'esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente R&D è un plus - L'esperienza nella gestione del progetto è un plus - Buon know-how negli strumenti software 3D CAD e FEM richiesti - Elevate aspettative sulla qualità del lavoro in tutti i settori - Personalità indipendente, proattiva e orientata agli obiettivi - Praticamente orientato e pratico modo di lavorare - Automotivata, impegnata, disposta ad imparare - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione - Ottimo comando di inglese e tedesco, sia scritto che parlato Ulteriori informazioni su di noi A Hitachi Energy, la nostra cultura è costruita su collaborazione, diversità e apprendimento continuo. Crediamo che le migliori idee derivino dal lavorare insieme in culture e discipline, abbracciando diverse prospettive e promuovendo un ambiente inclusivo. Incoraggiamo curiosità e innovazione, fornendo opportunità di crescita personale e professionale. Unisciti a noi e fai parte di un team globale che sta plasmando un futuro energetico sostenibile.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich-Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Engineer to strengthen our team for High Voltage Circuit Breakers development. If you are passionate about solving highly complex multi-physical problems and want to work with world-leading experts to develop best-in-class High Voltage Circuit Breakers, this is your chance. Join our innovative team and be part of an international working environment in Zurich. ## How you'll make an impact - Execute product-development-related engineering activities for specific R&D projects from concept to series implementation, ensuring technical alignment with cross-functional experts and project stakeholders - Support the Design Lead in product development topics and ensure structured documentation of development activities - Plan and supervise assembly, disassembly and inspection of prototypes together with other experts - Contribute to the continuous improvement of R&D processes and activities ## Your background - Master's degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related subject from a Polytechnical/Technical University - Working experience in an R&D environment is a plus - Experience in project management is a plus - Good know-how in 3D CAD and FEM software tools required - High expectations on quality of work in all regards - Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality - Practically oriented and hands-on way of working - Self-motivated, committed, willing to learn - Excellent communication skills - Excellent command of English and German, both written and spoken ## More about us At Hitachi Energy, our culture is built on collaboration, diversity and continuous learning. We believe that the best ideas come from working together across cultures and disciplines, embracing different perspectives and fostering an inclusive environment. We encourage curiosity and innovation, providing opportunities for personal and professional growth. Join us and be part of a global team that is shaping a sustainable energy future.
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Für unsere Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zürich-Oerlikon suchen wir einen R&D Engineer, um unser Team für die Entwicklung von High Voltage Circuit Breakers zu stärken. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich sind, hochkomplexe multiphysikalische Probleme zu lösen und mit weltführenden Experten zu arbeiten, um erstklassige High Voltage Circuit Breakers zu entwickeln, ist dies Ihre Chance. Begleiten Sie unser innovatives Team und sind Teil eines internationalen Arbeitsumfelds in Zürich. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Durchführung von produktentwicklungsbezogenen Engineering-Tätigkeiten für spezifische FuE-Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Seriendurchführung, Sicherstellung der technischen Ausrichtung mit funktionsübergreifenden Experten und Projektträgern - Unterstützung des Design Lead in Produktentwicklungsthemen und Gewährleistung einer strukturierten Dokumentation von Entwicklungsaktivitäten - Planung und Überwachung der Montage, Demontage und Inspektion von Prototypen zusammen mit anderen Experten - Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der FuE-Prozesse und -Aktivitäten Ihr Hintergrund - Masterstudium Maschinenbau oder ein eng verwandtes Fach einer Polytechnischen/Technischen Universität - Arbeitserfahrung in einem FuE-Umfeld ist ein Plus - Erfahrung im Projektmanagement ist ein Plus - Gutes Know-how in 3D CAD- und FEM-Softwarewerkzeugen erforderlich - Hohe Erwartungen an die Qualität der Arbeit in allen Bereichen - Unabhängige, proaktive und zielorientierte Persönlichkeit - Praktisch ausgerichtete und praktische Arbeitsweise - Selbst motiviert, engagiert, bereit zu lernen - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Ausgezeichneter Befehl von Englisch und Deutsch, geschrieben und gesprochen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy baut unsere Kultur auf Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und kontinuierlichem Lernen auf. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen von der Zusammenarbeit über Kulturen und Disziplinen kommen, verschiedene Perspektiven einschließen und ein inklusives Umfeld fördern. Wir fördern Neugier und Innovation und bieten Möglichkeiten für persönliches und berufliches Wachstum. Begleiten Sie uns und sind Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das eine nachhaltige Energie-Zukunft entwickelt.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Pour notre Business Unit High Voltage Products à Zurich-Oerlikon, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur R & D pour renforcer notre équipe pour le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes multi-physiques très complexes et que vous souhaitez travailler avec des experts de premier plan dans le monde pour développer les meilleurs disjoncteurs haute tension de classe, c'est votre chance. Rejoignez notre équipe innovante et faites partie d'un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous ferez un impact - Exécuter des activités d'ingénierie liées au développement de produits pour des projets de R-D spécifiques, du concept à la mise en oeuvre de séries, en assurant l'alignement technique avec les experts interfonctionnels et les intervenants du projet - Soutenir le responsable de la conception dans les thèmes de développement des produits et assurer la documentation structurée des activités de développement - Planifier et superviser le montage, le démontage et l'inspection des prototypes avec d'autres experts - Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et des activités de R-D Vos antécédents - Maîtrise en génie mécanique ou domaine étroitement lié d'une université polytechnique/technique - L'expérience de travail dans un environnement de R-D est un plus - L'expérience en gestion de projet est un plus - Bon savoir-faire en CAO 3D et outils logiciels FEM requis - Des attentes élevées en matière de qualité du travail dans tous les domaines - Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers les objectifs - Pratiquement orienté et pratique du travail - Automotivé, engagé, prêt à apprendre - Excellentes compétences en communication - Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand, écrits et parlés Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, notre culture repose sur la collaboration, la diversité et l'apprentissage continu. Nous croyons que les meilleures idées proviennent de la collaboration entre les cultures et les disciplines, de l'adoption de perspectives différentes et de la promotion d'un environnement inclusif. Nous encourageons la curiosité et l'innovation, offrant des possibilités de croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie d'une équipe mondiale qui façonne un avenir énergétique durable.

descriptions.it: Über die Position In unserem Werk BiMOS Backend in Lenzburg stellen wir effiziente und hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorensteuerungen und Wechselrichtersystemen her. Damit leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag, die Industrie, den öffentlichen und individuellen Verkehr energieeffizienter zu gestalten und andererseits ermöglicht unsere Technologie das Produzieren und Transportieren von erneuerbaren Energien vom Produktionsstandort hin zum Verbraucher. Unsere hoch-integrierte Industrie 4.0-Standard-Fertigung bietet ein spannendes und herausforderndes Arbeitsumfeld für den nächsten Quality Operator. Werde Teil der Energiewende und unterstütze uns, in unserer hochautomatisierten Fabrik qualitativ hervorragende Produkte her zu stellen. descriptions.it: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv zum reibungslosen Materialfluss beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Warehouse Specialist spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle in unserem Logistikbereich und sorgst dafür, dass Material und Waren termingerecht, sicher und korrekt bewegt, gelagert und bereitgestellt werden. Mit deinem Engagement trägst du dazu bei, Ordnung, Effizienz und Qualität in unseren Lagerprozessen sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Administrative Tätigkeiten Erfassen und Pflegen von Daten im ERP-System Erstellen von Lieferscheinen, Versandpapieren und internen Dokumenten Bearbeitung von Bestellungen und Rückmeldungen Telefonische und schriftliche Korrespondenz mit internen Stellen und Lieferanten Unterstützung der Logistikleitung bei Auswertungen und Reportings Logistik & Lager Aktive Mitarbeit bei Prozessoptimierung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (KVP) Einlagerung der Ware nach vorgegebenen Prozessen Kommissionieren, Verpacken und Versandvorbereitung Be- und Entladen von LKW Durchführung von Inventuren Ordnung und Sauberkeit im Lager sicherstellen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker\/in EFZ oder mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Logistik Erfahrung mit administrativen Tätigkeiten von Vorteil Gute PC-Kenntnisse (MS Office, ERP-Systeme SAP \/S4 HANA) Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Körperlich belastbar und teamfähig Staplerausweis Mehr über uns Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you will make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Quality Specialist in Production, you are responsible for ensuring product and process quality, as well as continuously improving our manufacturing operations. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain to ensure compliance with internal and external quality requirements. How you'll make an impact Create and maintain quality and inspection plans Support new products and production lines, including quality and reliability assessments Participate in PFMEA, DFMEA, and process development activities Monitor critical process parameters and ensure compliance with quality standards Lead NCR management and analyze deviations using methods such as Pareto, 8D, Ishikawa, or 5‑Why Maintain quality‑relevant documentation and support internal\/external audits (incl. customer and ISO) Support the digitalization and automation of the production lines Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, CI, and lead or support quality-related projects and outgoing inspections Your background Technical education or university degree in Quality Management, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Production Technology, or a similar field Several years of experience in a production environment, ideally in quality assurance and preferably in a ceramic or silicon molding industry Strong knowledge of quality methods (8D, FMEA, RCA, Control Plans) Experience in auditing and in preparing quality reports Excellent analytical skills and a structured way of working Strong communication skills and a collaborative, solution‑oriented mindset Fluent in German and English, written and spoken Ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule  Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team  English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule  Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team  English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: ## Descrizione L'opportunità Per rafforzare il nostro team, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Engineer – Grid Automation Control & Protection per supportare la riuscita consegna di progetti di automazione della rete in tutta Europa. In questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con la gestione dei progetti, i team di ingegneria e i clienti per fornire il campo di controllo e di protezione di complessi progetti di automazione delle sottostazione. Sarete parte di una comunità di ingegneria di livello mondiale all'interno del nostro hub europeo, lavorando insieme a colleghi esperti con profonda esperienza nell'esecuzione di progetti di grandi e tecnicamente impegnati in tutto il mondo. Questa posizione offre un ambiente eccellente per imparare, crescere e dare un contributo significativo allo scopo di Hitachi Energy di promuovere un sistema energetico sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro. È un'occasione unica per unire la transizione energetica in un momento in cui l'elettricità sta diventando sempre più la spina dorsale di una società sostenibile. # Come farai un impatto # - Collaborare con il team di progettazione per sviluppare concetti di protezione e controllo per sistemi di trasmissione (sotto), lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti durante la fase di progettazione di base - Contribuire e coordinare l'ambito tecnico dettagliato di Protezione e Controllo, lavorando in stretto allineamento con altre discipline ingegneristiche come SCADA e Network & Cyber Security - Sostenere la progettazione e/o la configurazione di protezione e controllo IED per le sottostazioni di trasmissione (sotto) garantendo soluzioni conformi alle specifiche del cliente - Partecipare e aiutare a condurre le attività di test di fabbrica presso le nostre strutture di test a Baden (Svizzera), tra cui i test di accettazione di fabbrica (FAT) effettuati in collaborazione con i clienti # Il tuo sfondo # - Corso di laurea in ingegneria elettrica o equivalente (ad esempio Technikerschule), con esperienza rilevante nei sistemi di automazione sottostazione - Conoscenza dei sistemi di controllo e protezione delle sottostazione, compresi gli standard di comunicazione come IEC 61850 - L'esperienza con il portafoglio IED di protezione e controllo di Hitachi Energy (famiglia Relion®) è un vantaggio - Giocatore di squadra con una forte attenzione alla soddisfazione del cliente, alla sicurezza, alla qualità e all'efficienza - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, coordinando efficacemente con più stakeholder in un ambiente di progetto - Forte capacità di comunicazione e fiducia nel prendere decisioni tecniche - Fluente in inglese, sia scritto che parlato, la lingua tedesca è un vantaggio ## More about us Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Engineer – Grid Automation Control & Protection to support the successful delivery of grid automation projects across Europe. In this role, you will collaborate closely with project management, fellow engineering teams, and customers to deliver the control and protection scope of complex substation automation projects. You will be part of a world class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and technically demanding projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, grow, and make a meaningful contribution to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to join the energy transition at a time when electricity is increasingly becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. ## How you'll make an impact - Collaborate with the project core team to develop protection and control concepts for (sub-)transmission systems, working closely with customers during the base design phase - Contribute to and coordinate the Protection & Control detailed engineering scope, working in close alignment with other engineering disciplines such as SCADA and Network & Cyber Security - Support the design and/or configuration of protection and control IEDs for (sub-)transmission substations, ensuring solutions meet customer specifications - Participate in and help lead factory testing activities at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland), including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) carried out in partnership with customers ## Your background - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent (e.g. Technikerschule), with relevant experience in substation automation systems - Knowledge of substation control and protection systems, including communication standards such as IEC 61850 - Experience with Hitachi Energy's protection and control IED portfolio (Relion® family) is an advantage - Open-minded team player with a strong focus on customer satisfaction, safety, quality, and efficiency - Ability to work independently while effectively coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a project environment - Strong communication skills and the confidence to take technical decisions - Fluent in English, both written and spoken, German language is an advantage ## More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen Projektingenieur – Grid Automation Control & Protection, um die erfolgreiche Lieferung von Netzautomatisierungsprojekten in ganz Europa zu unterstützen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie eng mit dem Projektmanagement, den Ingenieurteams und den Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um die Steuerung und den Schutz von komplexen Umspannwerksautomatisierungsprojekten zu gewährleisten. Sie werden Teil einer Weltklasse-Engineering-Community in unserem European Hub sein und gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kollegen mit tiefem Know-how bei der Umsetzung großer und technisch anspruchsvoller Projekte weltweit zusammenarbeiten. Diese Position bietet ein hervorragendes Umfeld, um ein nachhaltiges, flexibles und sicheres Energiesystem zu entwickeln, zu wachsen und einen sinnvollen Beitrag zu Hitachi Energy zu leisten. Es ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, der Energiewende zu einer Zeit beizutreten, in der Strom zunehmend zum Rückgrat einer nachhaltigen Gesellschaft wird. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projekt-Kernteam zur Entwicklung von Schutz- und Steuerungskonzepten für (Sub-)Transmissionssysteme, die eng mit Kunden in der Basisplanungsphase zusammenarbeiten - Um den detaillierten Engineering-Bereich von Protection & Control zu koordinieren und zu koordinieren, in enger Abstimmung mit anderen Ingenieurdisziplinen wie SCADA und Network & Cyber Security - Unterstützung der Konstruktion und/oder Konfiguration von Schutz- und Steuerungs-IEDs für (Unter-)Transmissions-Unterstationen, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen Kundenspezifikationen erfüllen - Nehmen Sie an und helfen Sie bei unseren Testanlagen in Baden (Schweiz), einschließlich Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), die in Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden durchgeführt werden Ihr Hintergrund - Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder Äquivalent (z.B. Technikerschule), mit relevanten Erfahrungen in Umspannautomationssystemen - Kenntnisse der Unterstations- und Schutzsysteme, einschließlich Kommunikationsstandards wie IEC 61850 - Erfahrung mit dem Schutz- und Kontrollportfolio von Hitachi Energy (Relion® Familie) ist ein Vorteil - Offener Teamplayer mit einem starken Fokus auf Kundenzufriedenheit, Sicherheit, Qualität und Effizienz - Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und effektiv mit mehreren Stakeholdern in einem Projektumfeld zu koordinieren - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und das Vertrauen in technische Entscheidungen - fließend in Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen, deutsche Sprache ist ein Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de projet – Grid Automation Control & Protection pour soutenir la livraison réussie de projets d'automatisation de réseau dans toute l'Europe. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec la gestion de projet, d'autres équipes d'ingénierie et des clients afin de fournir le contrôle et la protection des projets complexes d'automatisation des sous-stations. Vous ferez partie d'une communauté d'ingénieurs de calibre mondial au sein de notre European Hub, en collaboration avec des collègues expérimentés possédant une expertise approfondie dans l'exécution de grands projets techniquement exigeants dans le monde entier. Cette position offre un excellent environnement pour apprendre, grandir et apporter une contribution significative à l'objectif d'Hitachi Energy de faire progresser un système énergétique durable, flexible et sûr. C'est une occasion unique de rejoindre la transition énergétique à un moment où l'électricité devient de plus en plus l'épine dorsale d'une société durable. Comment vous ferez un impact - Collaborer avec l'équipe centrale du projet pour développer des concepts de protection et de contrôle pour les systèmes de (sous-)transmission, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les clients pendant la phase de conception de base - Contribuer à la protection et au contrôle et coordonner la portée technique détaillée, en travaillant en alignement étroit avec d'autres disciplines d'ingénierie telles que SCADA et Network & Cyber Security - Soutenir la conception et/ou la configuration des dispositifs de protection et de contrôle des sous-stations de transport, en veillant à ce que les solutions répondent aux spécifications du client - Participer et aider à des activités de test en usine dans nos installations d'essais à Baden (Suisse), y compris les tests d'acceptation en usine (FAT) réalisés en partenariat avec des clients Vos antécédents - Baccalauréat en génie électrique ou équivalent (par exemple Technikerschule), avec une expérience pertinente dans les systèmes d'automatisation des sous-stations - Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle et de protection des sous-stations, y compris les normes de communication telles que la CEI 61850 - Expérience de la protection et du contrôle du portefeuille IED d'Hitachi Energy (famille Rélion®) est un avantage - Joueur d'équipe ouvert d'esprit avec un accent fort sur la satisfaction des clients, la sécurité, la qualité et l'efficacité - Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en coordonnant efficacement avec plusieurs intervenants dans un environnement de projet - Fortes compétences en communication et confiance dans la prise de décisions techniques - La langue allemande est un avantage Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

descriptions.it: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità In qualità di specialista di qualità nella produzione, siete responsabili di garantire la qualità del prodotto e del processo, nonché di migliorare continuamente le nostre operazioni di produzione. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con Ingegneria, Produzione e Supply Chain per garantire il rispetto dei requisiti di qualità interni ed esterni. Come farete un impatto Creare e mantenere piani di qualità e di ispezione Supportare nuovi prodotti e linee di produzione, tra cui valutazioni di qualità e affidabilità Partecipare a PFMEA, DFMEA e attività di sviluppo dei processi Monitorare i parametri di processo critici e garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità Lead NCR gestione e analizzare le deviazioni utilizzando metodi come Pareto, 8D, Ishikawa, o 5-Perché mantenere la documentazione di qualità-relevant e sostenere i controlli interni/esterni. Sostenere la digitalizzazione e l'automazione delle linee di produzione Collaborare con Produzione, Ingegneria, Supply Chain, CI, e sostenere progetti legati alla qualità e ispezioni in uscita La vostra formazione tecnica o laurea in Gestione della qualità, Ingegneria meccanica, Scienza dei materiali, Tecnologia di produzione, o un campo simile Diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente di produzione, idealmente in garanzia della qualità e preferibilmente in un settore di stampaggio in ceramica o silicio Forte conoscenza dei metodi di qualità (8D, FMEA, RCA, Piani di controllo) Esperienza nell'auditing e nella preparazione di report di qualità Eccellente capacità analitiche e un modo strutturato di lavorare Forte capacità comunicative e una mentalità collaborativa e orientata alla soluzione Fluent in tedesco e inglese, scritto e parlato Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con team e stakeholder interfunzionali Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity As a Quality Specialist in Production, you are responsible for ensuring product and process quality, as well as continuously improving our manufacturing operations. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain to ensure compliance with internal and external quality requirements. How you'll make an impact Create and maintain quality and inspection plans Support new products and production lines, including quality and reliability assessments Participate in PFMEA, DFMEA, and process development activities Monitor critical process parameters and ensure compliance with quality standards Lead NCR management and analyze deviations using methods such as Pareto, 8D, Ishikawa, or 5‑Why Maintain quality‑relevant documentation and support internal\/external audits (incl. customer and ISO) Support the digitalization and automation of the production lines Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, CI, and lead or support quality-related projects and outgoing inspections Your background Technical education or university degree in Quality Management, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Production Technology, or a similar field Several years of experience in a production environment, ideally in quality assurance and preferably in a ceramic or silicon molding industry Strong knowledge of quality methods (8D, FMEA, RCA, Control Plans) Experience in auditing and in preparing quality reports Excellent analytical skills and a structured way of working Strong communication skills and a collaborative, solution‑oriented mindset Fluent in German and English, written and spoken Ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Als Qualitätsspezialist in der Produktion sind Sie für die Sicherstellung der Produkt- und Prozessqualität sowie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Fertigungsabläufe verantwortlich. Sie arbeiten eng mit Engineering, Produktion und Supply Chain zusammen, um die Einhaltung interner und externer Qualitätsanforderungen zu gewährleisten. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Erstellung und Aufrechterhaltung von Qualitäts- und Inspektionsplänen machen Support neuer Produkte und Produktionslinien, einschließlich Qualitäts- und Zuverlässigkeitsbewertungen Beteiligen Sie sich an PFMEA, DFMEA und Prozessentwicklungsaktivitäten Überwachen Sie kritische Prozessparameter und gewährleisten Sie die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards Führen Sie NCR-Management und analysieren Sie Abweichungen mithilfe von Methoden wie Pareto, 8D, Ishikawa oder 5‐War. Unterstützung der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung der Produktionslinien Zusammenarbeit mit Produktions-, Engineering-, Supply Chain-, CI- und Lead- oder Support-Qualitätsprojekte und ausgehenden Inspektionen Ihr Hintergrund Technische Ausbildung oder Hochschulabschluss in Qualitätsmanagement, Maschinenbau, Werkstoffwissenschaften, Produktionstechnik oder einem ähnlichen Bereich Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in einer Produktionsumgebung, ideal in der Qualitätssicherung und bevorzugt in einer Keramik- oder Silizium-Formindustrie Starkes Wissen über Qualitätsmethoden (8D, FMEA, RCA, Control Plans) Erfahrung im Auditing und bei der Erstellung von Qualitätsberichten Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein kollaboratives, lösungsorientiertes Mindset Fluent in Deutsch und Englisch, geschrieben und gesprochen Fähigkeit, effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und Stakeholdern zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de la qualité en production, vous êtes responsable de la qualité des produits et des procédés, ainsi que de l'amélioration continue de nos opérations de fabrication. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'ingénierie, la production et la chaîne d'approvisionnement afin d'assurer le respect des exigences de qualité internes et externes. Comment vous ferez un impact Créer et maintenir des plans de qualité et d'inspection Soutenir les nouveaux produits et les lignes de production, y compris les évaluations de la qualité et de la fiabilité Participer aux activités de PFMEA, DFMEA et d'élaboration des processus Surveiller les paramètres critiques des processus et assurer la conformité aux normes de qualité Diriger la gestion de la RCN et analyser les écarts à l'aide de méthodes telles que Pareto, 8D, Ishikawa ou 5‐Pourquoi Maintenir la documentation pertinente en matière de qualité et soutenir les vérifications internes/externes (y compris le client et l'ISO) Soutenir la numérisation et l'automatisation des lignes de production Collaborer avec Production, Ingénierie, Supply Chain, CI, et diriger ou soutenir des projets liés à la qualité et des inspections sortantes Votre formation Formation technique ou diplôme universitaire en gestion de la qualité, génie mécanique, science des matériaux, technologie de production, ou un domaine similaire Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un environnement de production, idéalement dans l'assurance de la qualité et de préférence dans une industrie de moulage en céramique ou en silicium. Expérience dans l'audit et la préparation de rapports de qualité Excellentes compétences analytiques et une façon structurée de travailler Fortes compétences en communication et un esprit collaboratif axé sur la solution Fluent en allemand et en anglais, écrit et parlé Capacité de travailler efficacement avec des équipes et des intervenants interfonctionnels Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: Join Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business as our Global Head of Sales. You will lead a global team driving commercial strategy and sales execution across a portfolio that includes enterprise software, automation and communications, power conversion solutions and services. This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of our global go-to-market transformation (Suisen)—focused on customer connection, agility, empowerment, and commercial excellence. You will work across product lines and regions to align diverse sales teams and deliver growth, while shaping how we serve customers in a rapidly evolving energy landscape. The location of this role is flexible globally and will be determined in subsequent stages. How You'll Make an Impact Lead global sales performance across all Grid Automation offerings. Manage a small central team of industry leaders and functional experts focused on global sales strategy and governance. Provide dotted-line leadership to sales leaders in global product groups and regional hubs. Align multiple sales operating models under a unified go-to-market strategy. Drive forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and deal governance. Champion customer-first sales execution and strategic account leadership. Accelerate growth in software, digital, and lifecycle-based offerings. Expand reach through partner ecosystems and channel programs. Collaborate with regional, product, and functional leaders to ensure execution. Lead through transformation, simplifying structures and empowering teams. Your Background 15+ years in global sales leadership roles in energy, software, or industrial sectors. Proven success managing complex, matrixed sales organizations. Experience leading sales transformation or go-to-market redesigns. Strong commercial acumen and forecasting discipline. Familiarity with enterprise software, automation, and power systems. Executive presence and ability to influence across functions and geographies. Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
