descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un Service Sales Engineer per la nostra Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, a Ginevra (Svizzera). Segnalando a Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita nell'area assegnata. Sarete parte del Team Vendite che si concentra sul Servizio Trasformatore Trazione in Europa. In qualità di Service Sales Engineer è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e servizi ferroviari per le apparecchiature di rotolamento stock. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per le apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se sei un ingegnere altamente qualificato e motivato che cerca di unirsi a un team dinamico, ti invitiamo a applicare. Sostenere il team di vendita e i clienti in tutto il processo di vendita, sviluppando al tempo stesso nuovi e esistenti business aumentando la conoscenza interna ed esterna dei prodotti e del mercato Preparazione dell'offerta tecnica in conformità con il portafoglio unità e la necessità del cliente. Rivendicare gli aspetti tecnici e commerciali dell'offerta Partecipando alle discussioni sulla strategia di vendita, assegnando obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine e negoziando i vari budget di vendita del Gruppo di prodotti e piani di marketing Identificare le esigenze dei clienti e le offerte dei concorrenti attraverso l'analisi del mercato, assicurando un'efficace azione di marketing e comunicazione dimostra la proposizione di valore dei prodotti, sistemi, servizi e pacchetti La tua laurea di primo livello in ingegneria e più di 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite dirette e delle vendite La conoscenza del mercato delle ferrovie e dei clienti ferroviari (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing) è un vantaggio Fluente in francese e inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione del conto e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi Comprensione di preparazione dell'offerta, negoziazione del contratto, gestione del rischio e termini commerciali e legali Viaggiare principalmente all'interno dell'Unione Europea se necessario. I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Mit der Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales und Marketing Manager unterstützen Sie die Vertriebsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses im zugewiesenen Bereich. Sie werden Teil des Vertriebsteams sein, das sich auf den Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, den nachhaltigen Mobilitätsübergang durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienenservice-Portfolio für Fahrzeuge zu erleichtern. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Peers mit langjähriger Erfahrung im On-Board Traktionstransformator-Service-Geschäft für Fahrzeuge. Mit Sitz in Genf übernimmt die Rolle für die Bahnkunden in Europa (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasingunternehmen). Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams und der Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses ausüben, während Sie neue und bestehende Unternehmen entwickeln, indem Sie interne und externe Kenntnisse der Produkte und des Marktes erhöhen. Erklären Sie technische und kommerzielle Aspekte des Angebots Participating in Sales-Strategie-Diskussionen, Zuordnung von kurzfristigen und langfristigen Zielen und Verhandeln der verschiedenen Produktgruppen-Vertriebsbudgets und Marketing-Pläne Identifikation der Kundenbedürfnisse und Konkurrenten Angebote durch Marktanalyse, Sicherstellung effizienter Marketing-Aktionen und Kommunikation zeigen die Wertvorstellung der Produkte, Systeme, Dienstleistungen und Pakete Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Direktverkaufs- und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse von Schienenfahrzeugen und Schienenkunden (OEM Zughersteller, Schienenbetreiber, Leasingunternehmen) ist ein Vorteil Fluent in Französisch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen. Andere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Kontomanagement und Cross-Selling über Systeme, Lösungen, Produkte und Dienstleistungskategorien Verstehen von Angebotsvorbereitung, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement und kommerzielle und rechtliche Bedingungen Reisen vor allem innerhalb der Europäischen Union bei Bedarf. Häufige Interaktion mit Schienenkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und professionelle Leistung zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre Unité Service Transformateurs de Traction, à Genève (Suisse). Relevant du Service de Traction Sales and Marketing Manager, vous accompagnerez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone affectée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des ventes qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que Service Sales Engineer, il s'agit de votre tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires de pointe et de services ferroviaires pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les divers budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, des systèmes, des services et des forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit\/solution\/service. Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients du rail (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience dans le développement des entreprises, la gestion des comptes et la vente croisée entre les systèmes, les solutions, les produits et les catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation des offres, de la négociation des contrats, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques Voyageant principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire. Une interaction fréquente avec les clients ferroviaires et HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team sont attendues Plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Sei pronto a contribuire a design di interruttori all'avanguardia e ottimizzare le soluzioni meccaniche? Il nostro team di Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un esperto ingegnere di progettazione meccanica per supportare la nostra innovazione nella tecnologia energetica. Se avete una mentalità creativa, una forte competenza tecnica, e un approccio strutturato per risolvere i problemi, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Come farete un Impact Developing and refining Switchgear disegni meccanici, tra cui la preparazione di disegni tecnici Utilizzando strumenti PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) per creare fatture di materiali e documentazione Proporre e sviluppare soluzioni innovative per l'ottimizzazione del design meccanico Condurre simulazioni meccaniche, con un focus sull'analisi dello stress per migliorare le prestazioni del sistema Il vostro sfondo Apprendistato completato nel design meccanico Creativo problem-solver con un approccio strutturato alle sfide tecniche Il nostro team si impegna a promuovere soluzioni energetiche, supportando la crescita e lo sviluppo professionali. Unisciti a noi e fai parte di una società che sta guidando il futuro della tecnologia del potere!
descriptions.en: The Opportunity Are you ready to contribute to cutting-edge switchgear designs and optimize mechanical solutions? Our team at Hitachi Energy is looking for a skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to support our innovation in power technology. If you have a creative mindset, strong technical expertise, and a structured approach to problem-solving, we would love to hear from you! How You'll Make an Impact Developing and refining switchgear mechanical designs, including preparing technical drawings Utilizing PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) tools to create bills of materials and documentation Proposing and developing innovative solutions for mechanical design optimization Conducting mechanical simulations, with a focus on stress analysis to enhance system performance Your Background Completed apprenticeship in mechanical design Creative problem-solver with a structured approach to technical challenges Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams More About Us At Hitachi Energy, we foster a dynamic work environment where innovation thrives. Our team is committed to advancing energy solutions while supporting professional growth and development. Join us and be part of a company that is driving the future of power technology!
descriptions.de: Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, zu modernsten Schaltanlagenkonstruktionen beizutragen und mechanische Lösungen zu optimieren? Unser Team von Hitachi Energy sucht einen erfahrenen Maschinenbauingenieur, der unsere Innovation in der Energietechnik unterstützt. Wenn Sie eine kreative Denkweise, eine starke technische Expertise und einen strukturierten Ansatz zur Problemlösung haben, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören! Wie Sie eine Wirkung entwickeln und verfeinern Schaltanlagen mechanische Designs, einschließlich der Vorbereitung technischer Zeichnungen Utilizing PLM (Produkt Lifecycle Management) Werkzeuge zur Erstellung von Material- und Dokumentationsrechnungen Bereitstellung und Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für die mechanische Designoptimierung Durchführung mechanischer Simulationen, mit Schwerpunkt auf Stressanalyse zur Verbesserung der Systemleistung Ihr Hintergrund abgeschlossene Ausbildung im mechanischen Design Kreative Problemlöser mit einem strukturierten Ansatz für technische Herausforderungen Unser Team setzt sich dafür ein, Energielösungen zu entwickeln und gleichzeitig professionelles Wachstum und Entwicklung zu unterstützen. Begleiten Sie uns und sind Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Energietechnologie treibt!
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à contribuer à la conception de commutateurs de pointe et à optimiser les solutions mécaniques? Notre équipe chez Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un ingénieur de conception mécanique qualifié pour soutenir notre innovation dans la technologie de l'énergie. Si vous avez un état d'esprit créatif, une solide expertise technique et une approche structurée de la résolution de problèmes, nous aimerions vous entendre ! Comment vous ferez un impact Développer et affiner les conceptions mécaniques de commutateurs, y compris la préparation de dessins techniques Utilisation des outils PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) pour créer des factures de matériaux et de documentation Proposer et développer des solutions innovantes pour l'optimisation de la conception mécanique Effectuer des simulations mécaniques, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse du stress pour améliorer la performance du système Votre Contexte Apprentissage terminé en conception mécanique Résoudre les problèmes créatifs avec une approche structurée aux défis techniques Des compétences de communication solides pour collaborer efficacement avec les équipes interfonctionnelles Plus À propos de nous Chez Hitachi Energy, nous favorisons un environnement de travail dynamique où l'innovation prospère. Notre équipe s'engage à faire progresser les solutions énergétiques tout en soutenant la croissance et le développement professionnels. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie d'une entreprise qui dirige l'avenir de la technologie de l'énergie!

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our IT team and contribute to modern application solutions in a dynamic environment. In this role, you support the full application lifecycle, from design to deployment. You work closely with experienced colleagues and gain hands‑on experience in development and system configuration. You will learn how digital applications create real business impact. Curiosity, ownership, and a structured mindset will help you succeed. You grow through responsibility, collaboration, and exposure to real projects. descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie oder Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungen zu optimieren und schaffen eine Umgebung, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden weiterentwickeln und wachsen können. ________________________________________________________ The opportunity We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Procurement Team Lead to join our fast-paced service organization at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are paramount. In this key leadership role, you will drive strategic sourcing initiatives, optimize procurement operations, and lead a talented team of approximately 12 procurement professionals. Your expertise will ensure the rapid and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services, all while upholding the highest standards of

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Business Intelligence Analyst within Hitachi Energy's Business Solution Team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between complex data and strategic action for our Grid Integration business. You will be responsible for designing and delivering customer-driven BI applications that empower our HVDC and Business unit-wide teams to make informed decisions. By ensuring that our front-end solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and governed by global standards, you will contribute directly to our digital transformation journey and the ambitious goal of improving business efficiency through data transparency. How you'll make an impact Develop and maintain a roadmap for new, customer-driven BI applications, ensuring that design and report interfaces meet the specific needs of our HVDC and GI projects Ensure that all BI implementations follow the established structure and guidelines. You will drive Master Data alignment and ensure data validity through rigorous quality assurance and interface management with our data warehouse storage Actively identify and capture new Business Intelligence demands across the organization, translating business requirements into reusable data flow architectures Run BI training sessions to empower the organization, managing the application lifecycle through dedicated support, service request resolution, and the proactive use of our ticketing systems Ensure all initiatives follow PPS (Project Power System) process guidelines, contributing to a transparent and auditable environment that supports both internal goals and regulatory requirements Your background Strong experience in BI design and report development, including a deep understanding of data collection methods and interface management with data warehouse environments Proven ability to create and maintain reusable data flow architectures and ensure alignment with Master Data management principles Experience in maintaining existing BI solutions, managing application roadmaps, and utilizing ticket systems to solve service requests and issues Exceptional skills in identifying business demands and communicating technical structures to non-technical stakeholders, including conducting training sessions for diverse user groups A firm commitment to following process guidelines (such as PPS) and ensuring that local implementations adhere to global organizational structures and BI guidelines Strong focus on data quality assurance and the ability to ensure data validity across complex, large-scale IT initiatives More about us We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptions.it: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a skilled and driven R&D Test and Process Engineer for Bushings with a specialized focus on high voltage (HV) testing and manufacturing process development . This role is critical in ensuring the performance, safety, and compliance of high voltage energy systems through rigorous testing, data analysis, and continuous process optimization. You will play a key role in bridging R&D and manufacturing, supporting the development of innovative energy technologies. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute high voltage testing activities in compliance with IEC, IEEE, and internal standards Design and implement test setups, selecting appropriate HV equipment and methodologies Analyze test data, document results, and support root cause investigations and corrective actions Collaborate with R&D and manufacturing teams to define test strategies and process requirements Drive continuous improvement in testing and prototyping processes to enhance efficiency and quality Ensure proper maintenance, calibration, and safe operation of HV test equipment Support prototyping activities and assess process feasibility in a manufacturing environment Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and company policies Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in high voltage testing. Process engineering experience is a plus. Strong knowledge of HV testing protocols, equipment, and safety practices Familiarity with IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and ISO 45001 standards Proficient in analyzing test data and conducting failure analyses Fluent in German and good English knowledge, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

titles.it: Ingegnere di manutenzione dell'attrezzatura di spostamento – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
titles.fr: Ingénieur d'entretien de l'équipement de poste – Échéance 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

descriptions.it: Mansioni - Mantenere e ottimizzare l'attrezzatura chimica e al plasma bagnati per garantire elevata disponibilità - Risoluzione dei problemi e sistemi complessi di riparazione in collaborazione con i partner OEM - Pianificare e sostenere attività di manutenzione preventiva per migliorare le prestazioni degli utensili - Gestire i pezzi di ricambio e contribuire agli aggiornamenti delle attrezzature e miglioramenti dei processi - Collaborare con team di ingegneria, R&D e operazioni per sostenere gli obiettivi di produzione - Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e supportare il monitoraggio dei dati nei sistemi MES - Identificare e implementare miglioramenti in strumenti, processi ed efficienza operativa - Garantire il rispetto degli standard HSE e promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro Requisiti - Formazione professionale tecnica nell'automazione, nell'elettronica o in un settore relativo (EFZ o equivalente) - 2+ anni di esperienza nella manutenzione delle attrezzature in semiconduttori o industrie simili - Forte conoscenza tecnica negli strumenti al plasma (ad es. sistemi AMAT, LAM) - Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, meccanica, pneumatica e sistemi di vuoto - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente orientato al team e all'interno delle operazioni a turni - Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Cosa? - Ti unirai a un ambiente di produzione dinamico e veloce in cui il lavoro di squadra, l'affidabilità e l'eccellenza tecnica sono fondamentali. - Lavorando in una configurazione a turni, sarete parte di un team di manutenzione altamente qualificato che supporta operazioni critiche e processi produttivi avanzati. - Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con tecnologie complesse e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità e alle prestazioni di produzione. Contatto - Unisciti al nostro team innovativo come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Shift e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel cuore della produzione di semiconduttori! - Con una forte attenzione ai processi di incisione, lavorerai con tecnologia all'avanguardia per ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e garantire operazioni senza interruzioni. - Questa è la tua opportunità di collaborare con gli esperti, contribuire a progetti innovativi e crescere in un ambiente dinamico e high-tech. - Se siete appassionati di precisione e innovazione, vogliamo sentirvi!
descriptions.en: ## Mansioni - Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability - Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners - Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance - Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements - Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals - Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems - Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency - Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment ## Requisiti - Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent) - 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries - Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems) - Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems - Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations - Good communication skills in English (German is a plus) ## Cosa offriamo - You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key. - Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes. - This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance. ## Contatto - Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! - With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. - This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. - If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!
descriptions.de: Mansion - Bewahren und optimieren nasse chemische und Plasma-Ätzgeräte, um hohe Verfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten - Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur komplexer Systeme in Zusammenarbeit mit OEM-Partnern - Planen und unterstützen vorbeugende Wartungsarbeiten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugleistung - Ersatzteile verwalten und zu Anlagen-Upgrades und Prozessverbesserungen beitragen - Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur-, FuE- und Betriebsteams zur Unterstützung von Produktionszielen - Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumentationen und Support-Datenverfolgung in MES-Systemen - Verbesserung von Werkzeugen, Prozessen und betrieblicher Effizienz identifizieren und implementieren - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von HSE-Standards und Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds Voraussetzungen - Technische Berufsbildung in Automatisierung, Elektronik oder einem verwandten Bereich (EFZ oder Äquivalent) - 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Wartung von Geräten in Halbleitern oder ähnlichen Industrien - Starkes technisches Wissen in Plasmawerkzeugen (z.B. AMAT, LAM-Systeme) - Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik, Pneumatik und Vakuumsystemen - Fähigkeit, in einem teamorientierten Umfeld und innerhalb von Schichtbetrieben zu arbeiten - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus) Cosa offriamo - Sie werden sich einer dynamischen und schnellen Produktionsumgebung anschließen, in der Teamarbeit, Zuverlässigkeit und technische Exzellenz entscheidend sind. - Sie arbeiten in einem Schichtaufbau, werden Teil eines hochqualifizierten Wartungsteams sein, das kritische Operationen und fortgeschrittene Fertigungsprozesse unterstützt. - Diese Rolle bietet praktische Erfahrungen mit komplexen Technologien und die Möglichkeit, Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und direkt zur Produktionsstabilität und Leistungsfähigkeit beizutragen. Contattoo - Begleiten Sie unser innovatives Team als Shift Maintenance Engineer und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle im Herzen der Halbleiterproduktion! - Mit einem starken Fokus auf Ätzprozessen arbeiten Sie mit modernster Technologie, um die Systemleistung zu optimieren und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. - Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, mit Experten zusammenzuarbeiten, zu bahnbrechenden Projekten beizutragen und in einem dynamischen, High-Tech-Umfeld zu wachsen. - Wenn Sie Leidenschaft für Präzision und Innovation sind, wollen wir von Ihnen hören!
descriptions.fr: Mansioni - Maintenez et optimisez les équipements chimiques et plasmatiques humides pour assurer une grande disponibilité - Systèmes complexes de dépannage et de réparation en collaboration avec les partenaires OEM - Planifier et soutenir les activités de maintenance préventive pour améliorer la performance des outils - Gérer les pièces de rechange et contribuer à la modernisation du matériel et à l ' amélioration des procédés - Collaborer avec les équipes du génie, de la R-D et des opérations pour appuyer les objectifs de production - Créer et maintenir la documentation technique et le suivi des données dans les systèmes MES - Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans les outils, les processus et l'efficacité opérationnelle - Assurer le respect des normes HSE et promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr Requisiti - Formation professionnelle technique en automatisation, en électronique ou dans un domaine connexe (EFZ ou équivalent) - 2+ ans d'expérience dans l'entretien des équipements dans les industries semi-conducteurs ou similaires - Forte connaissance technique des outils plasma (par exemple AMAT, systèmes LAM) - Compréhension solide des systèmes électroniques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et de vide - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement axé sur l'équipe et dans le cadre d'opérations par équipes - Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (l'allemand est un plus) Cosa offriamo - Vous rejoindrez un environnement de production dynamique et rapide où le travail d'équipe, la fiabilité et l'excellence technique sont essentiels. - Travaillant dans une configuration basée sur le poste, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de maintenance hautement qualifiée soutenant des opérations critiques et des processus de fabrication avancés. - Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique avec des technologies complexes et la possibilité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant directement à la stabilité de la production et aux performances. Contatto - Rejoignez notre équipe innovante en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance de quart et jouez un rôle crucial au cœur de la production de semi-conducteurs ! - Avec une forte focalisation sur les processus de gravure, vous travaillerez avec une technologie de pointe pour optimiser les performances du système et assurer des opérations sans faille. - C'est l'occasion de collaborer avec des experts, de contribuer à des projets novateurs et de grandir dans un environnement dynamique et de haute technologie. - Si vous êtes passionné par la précision et l'innovation, nous voulons vous entendre !

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team. Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position In unserem Profit Center in Wettingen produzieren und offerieren wir innovative, zuverlässige und sichere Überspannungsschutzlösungen für die Segmente Stromerzeugung\/-verteilung sowie Railway und Industrie. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit mit hochwertigen Technologien zu unterstützen und nachhaltige Mehrwerte zu schaffen. Dies gelingt durch die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologien sowie durch die stetige Verbesserung unserer Prozesse – getragen von offener Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Teamgeist. Als Teamleiter Instandhaltung übernimmst du eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle und führst ein engagiertes Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für die zuverlässige Funktion aller Produktionsanlagen und technischen Systeme in einer hochautomatisierten Prozessfertigung. Aktiv gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung der Instandhaltung – sowohl strategisch als auch operativ – und arbeitest dabei eng und partnerschaftlich mit der Geschäftsleitung sowie anderen Bereichen zusammen. Ziel ist es, eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit, Sicherheit sowie eine effiziente und nachhaltige Organisation sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Gemeinsam mit deinem Team wird die Instandhaltungsorganisation weiterentwickelt und gestärkt Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung von Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen (präventiv, korrektiv und ganzheitlich) liegen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich Nachhaltige Strategien zur Verbesserung von Verfügbarkeit, Produktivität und Lebensdauer der Anlagen werden von dir initiiert und vorangetrieben Die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung deines Teams wird aktiv unterstützt und gefördert Verantwortung für die Budgetplanung sowie ein bewusster und nachhaltiger Umgang mit Ressourcen (inkl. Ersatzteile und Lagerstrategie) gehören zu deiner Rolle In Umbau-, Neubau- und Investitionsprojekten arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen Die Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsstandards wird durch dich sichergestellt Prozesse werden kontinuierlich verbessert und durch moderne, digitale Lösungen sowie Kennzahlensysteme ergänzt Das bringst du mit Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Ingenieurwesen, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine Grundlage Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung sowie idealerweise in einer leitenden Rolle innerhalb einer automatisierten Produktion bringst du mit Kenntnisse in Automatisierungs-, Roboter- und Steuerungssystemen sind vorhanden Erfahrung mit strukturierten Instandhaltungsansätzen sowie kontinuierlicher Verbesserung rundet dein Profil ab Die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen bereitet dir Freude Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, Menschen zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln, zeichnet dich aus Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle unterstützen dich dabei, Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander zu verbinden. descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist part of the local HSE team, you will play a key role in participating to HSE development, with main focus on Environmental topic, but granting a good support on Health & Safety activities. Key tasks on the Environmental side will be related to safeguarding our site's environmental integrity and driving our sustainability ambitions forward. In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence. On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations. Please submit your application in English. How you'll make an impact Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU) Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation. Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders. Your background Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts Excellent command of Office 365 applications Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders Fluent in Italian and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Descrizione Hitachi Energy è leader globale nelle tecnologie energetiche e rinnovabili che permettono ai clienti di utilità e industria di migliorare le loro prestazioni riducendo al contempo l'impatto ambientale. CHSEM fornisce dispositivi semiconduttori ad alta potenza ai clienti interni Hitachi Energy (ad esempio HVDC, GPQSS) e ai clienti esterni. L'Ingegnere di Qualità del Materiale Senior garantisce la qualità, la robustezza e l'affidabilità a lungo termine delle materie prime critiche utilizzate nella produzione di dispositivi semiconduttori BiMOS presso la struttura di fabbricazione di Lenzburg. Essendo un'autorità tecnica, il ruolo gestisce in modo indipendente complessi argomenti di qualità legati ai materiali e ai fornitori, contribuisce alla strategia di qualità dei fornitori e supporta sia lo sviluppo delle capacità dei fornitori che del team per consentire operazioni stabili e scalabili. Mansioni - Guidare l'approccio di qualità del materiale per le materie prime critiche utilizzate nelle operazioni di BiMOS - Definire e migliorare continuamente i concetti e le strategie di controllo CTQ - condurre indagini complesse sulla qualità dei materiali relative a deviazioni, rese e problemi di affidabilità - Monitorare e sviluppare le prestazioni dei fornitori e garantire un'efficace attuazione delle azioni correttive - Qualifica del materiale di piombo, riqualificazione e attività di gestione del cambiamento - Supporta la produzione con competenze tecniche durante la produzione, la risoluzione dei problemi e le fasi di rampa - Guidare iniziative di miglioramento interfunzionale per migliorare qualità, affidabilità e efficienza dei costi - Agire come riferimento tecnico, supporto o mentoring ingegneri e rafforzare le capacità di fornitori e team Requisiti - Corso di laurea o master in Scienze dei materiali, Chimica, Fisica, o un campo correlato - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella qualità dei materiali, nella qualità dei fornitori o nella produzione di semiconduttori - Revisore certificato (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, o equivalente) - Forte conoscenza della qualità dei materiali, del controllo dei processi e della gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di produzione - Prova capacità di gestire in modo indipendente i problemi complessi di qualità dei materiali e dei fornitori - Esperienza con metodi di qualità strutturati come 8D, Six Sigma o equivalente Cosa? - Giorni extra tra Natale e Capodanno - Pasti sottosidrati nelle località con mense - 50% di sconto sui corsi principali presso i nostri frigoriferi FELFEL - Sconto sugli iscritti a vari centri fitness - Sconti su vari prodotti e servizi - Prestazioni pensionistiche interessanti con il nostro fondo pensionistico aziendale - Diversità: Promozione della diversità e inclusione - Offerte culturali, carte di credito, benzina, ecc.)
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. ## Mansioni - Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations - Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies - Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues - Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions - Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities - Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases - Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency - Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities ## Requisiti - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field - Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing - Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) - Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment - Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues - Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent ## Cosa offriamo - Extra days off between Christmas and New Year - Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens - 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges - Discount on memberships at various fitness centres - Discounts on various products and services - Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund - Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion - Cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Strom- und Erneuerbaren Technologien, mit denen Kunden aus der Energieversorgung und Industrie ihre Leistung verbessern und gleichzeitig die Umweltauswirkungen senken können. CHSEM bietet leistungsstarke Halbleiter-Geräte an Hitachi Energy interne Kunden (z.B. HVDC, GPQSS) sowie externe Kunden. Der Senior Material Quality Engineer gewährleistet die Qualität, Robustheit und langfristige Zuverlässigkeit von kritischen Rohstoffen, die bei der Herstellung von BiMOS-Halbleitergeräten in der Lenzburg-Fabrik eingesetzt werden. Als technische Behörde fungiert die Rolle selbstständig für komplexe material- und lieferantenbezogene Qualitätsthemen, trägt zur Lieferantenqualitätsstrategie bei und unterstützt sowohl die Lieferanten- als auch die Teamfähigkeitsentwicklung, um stabile und skalierbare Operationen zu ermöglichen. Mansion - Fahren Sie den Materialqualitätsansatz für kritische Rohstoffe, die im BiMOS-Betrieb verwendet werden - CTQ Konzepte und Steuerungsstrategien definieren und kontinuierlich verbessern - Führen komplexe Materialqualitätsuntersuchungen im Zusammenhang mit Abweichungen, Ertrag und Zuverlässigkeit - Überwachen und entwickeln Lieferantenleistung und gewährleisten eine effektive Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen - Hauptmaterialqualifikation, Requalifikation und Change Management Aktivitäten - Unterstützung der Produktion mit technischem Know-how während der Produktion, der Fehlerbehebung und der Rampenphase - Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Verbesserungsinitiativen, um Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz zu verbessern - Akt als technische Referenz, Unterstützung oder Mentoring Ingenieure und Stärkung von Lieferanten und Teamfähigkeiten Voraussetzungen - Bachelor- oder Masterstudium Materialwissenschaften, Chemie, Physik oder ein verwandten Bereich - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Materialqualität, Lieferantenqualität oder Halbleiterherstellung - Zertifizierter Prüfer (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 oder gleichwertig) - Starkes Wissen über Materialqualität, Prozesskontrolle und Risikomanagement in einem Fertigungsumfeld - bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Material- und Lieferantenqualitätsfragen unabhängig zu verwalten - Erfahrung mit strukturierten Qualitätsmethoden wie 8D, Six Sigma oder gleichwertig Cosa offriamo - Extratage zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr - Geförderte Mahlzeiten an den Standorten mit Kantinen - 50% Rabatt auf Hauptkurse in unseren FELFEL Kühlschränken - Rabatt auf Mitgliedschaften in verschiedenen Fitnesscentern - Rabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen - Attraktive Pensionsleistungen mit unserem Firmenrentenfonds - Vielfalt: Förderung von Vielfalt und Integration - Kulturangebote, Kreditkarten, Benzin usw.)
descriptions.fr: Descrizione Hitachi Energy est un leader mondial dans le domaine de l'énergie et des technologies renouvelables qui permet aux clients des services publics et de l'industrie d'améliorer leurs performances tout en réduisant l'impact environnemental. CHSEM fournit des dispositifs semi-conducteurs de haute puissance aux clients internes d'Hitachi Energy (p. ex. HVDC, GPQSS) ainsi qu'aux clients externes. Le Senior Material Quality Engineer assure la qualité, la robustesse et la fiabilité à long terme des matières premières critiques utilisées dans la production de semi-conducteurs BiMOS à l'usine de fabrication de Lenzburg. Agissant en tant qu'autorité technique, ce rôle gère de manière indépendante des sujets complexes liés à la qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs, contribue à la stratégie de qualité des fournisseurs et soutient le développement des capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes pour permettre des opérations stables et évolutives. Mansioni - Conduire l'approche de qualité des matières premières critiques utilisées dans les opérations BiMOS - Définir et améliorer continuellement les concepts de CTQ et les stratégies de contrôle - Mener des enquêtes complexes sur la qualité des matériaux liées aux écarts, au rendement et à la fiabilité - Surveiller et développer le rendement des fournisseurs et assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des mesures correctives - Qualification du matériel principal, requalification et gestion du changement - Soutenir la production avec une expertise technique pendant les phases de production, de dépannage et de montée en charge - Lancer des initiatives d'amélioration interfonctionnelles pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité et le rapport coût-efficacité - Agir comme référence technique, soutenir ou encadrer les ingénieurs et renforcer les capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des matériaux, chimie, physique ou domaine connexe - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la qualité des matériaux, la qualité des fournisseurs ou la fabrication de semi-conducteurs - Auditeur certifié (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 ou équivalent) - Forte connaissance de la qualité des matériaux, du contrôle des procédés et de la gestion des risques dans un environnement manufacturier - Capacité éprouvée de gérer indépendamment les problèmes complexes de qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs - Expérience avec des méthodes de qualité structurées telles que 8D, Six Sigma, ou équivalent Cosa offriamo - Jours de congé supplémentaires entre Noël et le Nouvel An - Repas subventionnés sur place avec cantines - Remise de 50% sur les cours principaux de nos réfrigérateurs FELFEL - Réduction sur les abonnements dans divers centres de fitness - Réductions sur différents produits et services - Prestations de retraite attractives avec notre fonds de pension d'entreprise - Diversité : promotion de la diversité et de l'inclusion - Offres culturelles, cartes de crédit, essence, etc.)

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptions.fr: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
