descriptions.it: The opportunity In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated R&D Electrical Validation Engineer. How you'll make an impact Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptions.it: Possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di un esecutivo dinamico ed esperto per l'acquisto che rafforza il nostro team di assistenza dedicato a Hitachi, Ltd., dove velocità e qualità sono della massima importanza. In questa posizione chiave, conduci iniziative di acquisto strategiche, ottimizza i processi di approvvigionamento e gestisci un team di talento di circa 12 esperti di shopping. La vostra esperienza garantisce un approvvigionamento rapido e conveniente di beni e servizi, mantenendo al contempo i più elevati standard di qualità e promuovendo rapporti di partnership a lungo termine con i fornitori. Questo ti permette di assumere la leadership, la promozione e l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro team di acquisto e creare una cultura aziendale orientata alle prestazioni e responsabile. Sviluppano e implementano concetti di approvvigionamento innovativi secondo la nostra strategia di servizio. In questo modo, ponete particolare attenzione alla consegna tempestiva, al miglioramento continuo della qualità, al miglioramento dell'efficienza della supply chain e alla riduzione dei costi sostenibile. L'applicazione del metodo Critical-Path per garantire i processi di approvvigionamento tempestivo e per ridurre al minimo i ritardi di consegna è uno dei vostri compiti principali. Garantiscono un'eccellenza costante in tutto il processo di acquisto – dalla determinazione della domanda al pagamento – e garantiscono processi chiari e massima trasparenza. Definiscono e controllano la segmentazione dei fornitori e sviluppano strategie di approvvigionamento mirate. Inoltre, sei responsabile per la selezione, la qualificazione e le trattative contrattuali con i fornitori. Con la costruzione di partnership strategiche a livello di leadership e la creazione di sistemi di gestione dei fornitori robusti con KPI, schede di punteggio, recensioni regolari e processi di escalation, è possibile garantire le prestazioni sostenibili della nostra rete di fornitori. Lavorano a stretto contatto con team interdipartimentali come la pianificazione dei materiali, l'ingegneria, la qualità e il controllo, al fine di ottimizzare l'acquisto alle esigenze aziendali. Essi controllano i rischi legati all'acquisto, tra cui interruzioni della supply chain, fluttuazioni dei prezzi e problemi di conformità. Questo ti porta a studi completi nel campo della gestione della supply chain, della gestione aziendale, dell'ingegneria o della formazione comparabile con esperienza professionale rilevante. Almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'acquisto o nella gestione della supply chain o almeno 3 anni di esperienza di leadership in un'area collegata. I successi rilevabili nell'acquisto strategico, nei negoziati e nella gestione del fornitore o del cliente sono vantaggiosi. Ottima comprensione dei processi di acquisto, diritto contrattuale e principi della catena di fornitura. Competenze analitiche impressionate e problem-solving e decision-making. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali. Ottima conoscenza del software di acquisto (ad esempio SAP Ariba) e Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel. Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente internazionale veloce e gestire più priorità. L'esperienza nella produzione, nella tecnologia o nell'industria è molto auspicabile. I nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili consentono di ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere. descriptions.en: The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato con l'attenzione su Automazione e Robotica per ottimizzare e migliorare l'efficienza delle nostre linee di produzione Interruttore Isolato Gas (GIS). Questo ruolo comporta l'applicazione di principi di ingegneria industriale, tecnologie di automazione e soluzioni robotiche per migliorare i processi produttivi, ridurre i rifiuti e migliorare la produttività. I laureati motivati con una forte attenzione all'automazione e alla robotica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare. Mansioni - Analizzare i layout delle linee di produzione GIS attuali, i flussi di lavoro e le procedure operative per identificare le aree per il miglioramento dell'efficienza, dei costi e della qualità, con un focus sul potenziale di automazione - Progettazione e realizzazione di processi produttivi ottimizzati, tra cui nuove metodologie, concetti di automazione, applicazioni robotiche, utilizzo di attrezzature e flusso di materiale - Condurre gli studi di tempo e di movimento, la mappatura dei processi e l'analisi del flusso di valore per identificare i colli di bottiglia ed eliminare le attività non a valore aggiunto - Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni di lavoro per il montaggio e il test GIS, compresi i processi automatizzati e assistiti da robot - Collaborare con altri ingegneri industriali, responsabili della produzione, ingegneri di design, team di implementazione di qualità e nuovi prodotti - Condurre e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, tra cui i progetti Lean Manufacturing e Six Sigma, sfruttando le tecnologie di digitalizzazione e automazione - Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie, tra cui robotica (ad esempio cobot), sistemi automatizzati e soluzioni di produzione intelligenti per l'ambiente di produzione GIS Requisiti - Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Robotica, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, o un campo correlato - L'esperienza professionale iniziale nell'ingegneria industriale all'interno di un ambiente di produzione è preferita - Esperienza iniziale o comprovata con l'automazione industriale e/o l'integrazione robotica (ad esempio, celle robotiche, cobot, sistemi automatizzati di gestione dei materiali) - Forte sfondo nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, principi di produzione magra e metodologie di miglioramento continuo (ad esempio, Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Proficienza negli strumenti di analisi dei processi (ad esempio, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo, controllo dei processi statistici) - Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente - La familiarità con i processi di produzione GIS o la produzione di apparecchiature elettriche complesse simili è altamente auspicabile - Fluente commerciale in inglese e tedesco Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. descriptions.en: ## L'opportunità We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. ## Mansioni - Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential - Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow - Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities - Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes - Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team - Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies - Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment ## Requisiti - Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field - Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred - Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) - Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously - Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable - Business fluent in English and German ## Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. ## Contatto No contact information provided.

Évaluer, spécifier et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies, y compris la robotique (par exemple, les robots), les systèmes automatisés et les solutions de fabrication intelligente pour l'environnement de production du SIG Requisiti - descriptions.it: In Hitachi, stiamo plasmando il futuro con precisione, innovazione e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. Analisi delle figure chiave rilevanti e preparazione di rapporti sulle prestazioni delle merci in uscita, identificazione e implementazione del potenziale di miglioramento, nonché introduzione di nuove tecnologie, garantire una gestione fluida delle formalità doganali ed esportazione. descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Industrial Engineering team, where team members work within two clearly differentiated focus areas: production development and industrial engineering. Each role has a defined main focus in one of these domains, while both profiles collaborate closely within the same team and contribute to shared production goals. Depending on your background, you will take ownership of one focus area while staying connected to the broader engineering activities. descriptions.it: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptions.it: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy High Voltage Service supports customers worldwide with after-sales services for generator circuit breakers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS). The team works closely with customers globally on installation, commissioning, maintenance, retrofitting and modernization. In this role, you will be closely involved with the product and work on construction sites around the world. Continuous learning, teamwork and professional development are an integral part of your daily work. descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our team to drive the implementation of the latest internal and external standards in our Dry Transformers across all the factories in HUB Europe. This role offers you an exciting opportunity to broaden your expertise across various disciplines and functions, engage in dynamic projects and build a strong professional network both within and outside our organization. How you'll make an impact Be an active member of International Standards Committees, staying up to date with emerging changes and requirements and influencing standards development Support Product Management in developing and implementing our Global Technology Platform by engaging in requirements definition and supporting the rollout phases Work with teams from various functions, including Engineering, Operations and Quality. You will establish and maintain both internal and external networks to facilitate information exchange Oversee operations across multiple factories and work towards operational harmonization Ensure the effective implementation of both internal and external standards within our Power Transformers Units in Europe by conducting audits, identifying gaps and facilitating their resolution Responsible for communicating updates, deliver training sessions and provide support and technical guidance to colleagues on Standards Compliance related questions Represent our Company in standards-related discussions with customers and industry stakeholders Your background Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical are preferred) About 10 to 15 years of experience in the Power Transformer field Experience in Project Management and managing functional teams Deep knowledge of transformers design, manufacturing, testing and operations Interest in AI tools and their potential integration into one's work L6S green belt is preferred Excellent intercultural sensitivity and ability to develop and maintain healthy working relationships Strong communication skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule  Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team  English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact   • Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team • Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement • Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams • Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization • Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment • Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions • Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities • Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation • Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background   • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent • 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products • Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies • Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills • Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics • Strong communication and presentation skills • Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems.  As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

descriptions.it: The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Zur Verstärkung unserer Front-End-Sales-Organisation suchen wir einen Head of Bid & Proposal, der eine zentrale Rolle im Verkaufsteam Schweiz übernimmt. In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bid-&-Proposal- sowie Order-Handling-Teams mit klarer Ausrichtung auf Wachstum und Geschäftsergebnisse im Einklang mit der Hitachi-Energy-Strategie Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen, Strukturen und Prozessen zur Sicherstellung eines leistungsfähigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams Gesamtverantwortung für Angebotsprozesse und Auftragsabwicklung im Produktgeschäft für den Schweizer Markt – termingerecht, qualitäts- und kundengerecht Sicherstellung der fristgerechten, korrekten und regelkonformen Angebotsabgabe gemäss Kunden-, Vertrags- und internen Anforderungen Entwicklung und Steuerung von Angebotsstrategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal sowie den Werken Aktive Gestaltung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktion sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Angebotsmanagement‑Prozesse Vorleben der Hitachi-Energy-Werte, insbesondere Sicherheit und Integrität Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor\/Master) im technischen oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich; betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation von Vorteil Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Bid & Proposal oder Projektmanagement Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder‑Strukturen Branchenkenntnisse im Energiesektor sowie ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung Tiefes Verständnis von Ausschreibungs‑ und Auftragsabwicklungsprozessen, inkl. SAP‑Grundlagen, kaufmännischer Abläufe, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risiko‑ sowie Claims‑Management Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, Team-Player Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, engagierten und kollaborativen Umfeld Klare Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch strukturierte Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt Eine einzigartige Kultur: Bringen Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihre Ideen ein und gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. Hybrid‑ und Remote‑Optionen Attraktives, wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs‑ und Leistungspaket

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

descriptions.it: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our team to drive the implementation of the latest internal and external standards in our Dry Transformers across all the factories in HUB Europe. This role offers you an exciting opportunity to broaden your expertise across various disciplines and functions, engage in dynamic projects and build a strong professional network both within and outside our organization. How you'll make an impact Be an active member of International Standards Committees, staying up to date with emerging changes and requirements and influencing standards development Support Product Management in developing and implementing our Global Technology Platform by engaging in requirements definition and supporting the rollout phases Work with teams from various functions, including Engineering, Operations and Quality. You will establish and maintain both internal and external networks to facilitate information exchange Oversee operations across multiple factories and work towards operational harmonization Ensure the effective implementation of both internal and external standards within our Power Transformers Units in Europe by conducting audits, identifying gaps and facilitating their resolution Responsible for communicating updates, deliver training sessions and provide support and technical guidance to colleagues on Standards Compliance related questions Represent our Company in standards-related discussions with customers and industry stakeholders Your background Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical are preferred) About 10 to 15 years of experience in the Power Transformer field Experience in Project Management and managing functional teams Deep knowledge of transformers design, manufacturing, testing and operations Interest in AI tools and their potential integration into one's work L6S green belt is preferred Excellent intercultural sensitivity and ability to develop and maintain healthy working relationships Strong communication skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Our High Voltage Products division is a worldwide specialist in power transmission and distribution. Our Service Unit supports customers around the globe with Generator Circuit Breaker systems (GCB) and gas‑insulated switchgear (GIS). From training and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and replacements — we ensure critical power infrastructure works reliably, safely, and efficiently. Service is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our international service team, you'll take on varied, hands‑on work and become a recognized product expert. After comprehensive, practical training in Switzerland, you'll travel the world to commission and maintain GCB systems — all while working in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This is a role with real impact, technical depth, and plenty of room to grow. How you´ll make an impact Lead multicultural service projects for GCB on power plants from 20 MW to 1600 MW worldwide Ensure smooth and timely execution of installation and maintenance work on site Perform the final quality check and guarantee that all work meets our high standards Deliver product training directly to customers at their facilities Identify risks proactively and implement effective mitigation measures Coordinate on‑site teams and give practical, clear instructions Manage resource and provide regular reporting to project management Drive process improvements and implement efficiency‑boosting initiatives on site Your background Completed apprenticeship in metalwork, electrical engineering, or automotive technology Solid electrical knowledge (essential); further education such as a technician diploma is a plus Minimum 2 years of professional experience; experience in site leadership is an advantage Good English skills (B2 or above); German is a plus High willingness to travel — up to 80% worldwide Flexible, resilient, and communicative team player who enjoys solving problems pragmatically and values high safety and quality standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva and shape the future of energy. As a Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge transformer technologies in a dynamic, international environment. You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund

descriptions.it: The opportunity As   high   voltage lab   engineer , you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology   to be used in   high voltage products.   In this position, you can test innovative ideas,   implement   new measurement and   diagnostics   methods, while you   maintain   a functional and   safe   testing environment .   Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology   and work towards   a sustainable and exciting future in energy.     How you will   make an impact:   Run and   maintain   state-of-the-art   high voltage labs   Participate actively in planning,   preparation   and execution of high voltage tests   Collaborate closely with a team of scientists and technicians from research   Bring your active contribution to the definition of safe testing practices in the lab during all phases of the experiments with the support   of local HSE partners and research team   Interact with partners in the adjacent Hitachi Energy high voltage labs and business units.     W hat you   will   bring:   Education in electrical engineering with at least a   bachelor   degree (FH)   Proven experience in lab work, including experimental setup with advanced measurement methods   Knowledge of lab integrated programming using LabView,   Matlab   or Python is very much welcome   Skills in data analysis are a plus.   Past experience   in high voltage   lab   is   advantageous .   Conversational level in English is   required,   good knowledge of German language is very appreciated.   More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

descriptions.it: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact   You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided)   You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment   You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

descriptions.it: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. • Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hitachi Energy bietet Dir interessante • Aufgaben in einem hoch motivierten Engineering Team im Bereich Technical Project Engineering. Hier beschäftigst Du dich mit dem Design und Abwickeln von Umrichter-Systemen in den Bereichen Power Quality (STATCOM), Bahnnetzkupplungen, Netzkupplungen und Pumpspeicheranlagen. descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation, experience in robot handling is advantageous Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in English, German highly beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Mitarbeiter Endprüfung bei Hitachi Energy bist du ein entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte vor der Freigabe höchsten Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Dokumentationsanforderungen entsprechen. Mit deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein und deinem strukturierten Vorgehen trägst du maßgeblich zur Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden bei. Das kannst du bewirken Testen von Generatorleistungsschaltern im Prüffeld (80%): Prüfen der Generator Leistungsschalter gemäss vorgegebenem Prüfplan Bewertung der Messergebnisse Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen in Englischer Sprache Erkennen von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Analyse und Korrektur von Verdrahtungsfehlern im Steuerschrank Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Prüfen der zugeteilten Schalter (zeitlicher Ablauf sowie Qualität der Prüfung) Mitarbeit bei der Verbesserung des Messequipments sowie der Prüfprozesse Montage- und Verdrahtungsarbeiten (20%): Selbstständige Verdrahtung von Baugruppen und Schaltersystemen gemäss Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenauftrag, Elektroschema, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Montage von PGHV-Produkten entsprechend der in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Lesen und verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (Automatiker EFZ, o.ä.) Erfahrung im lesen und verstehen von elektrischen Schemas, Montagezeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen Kenntnisse der Prüfung elektrischer Maschinen und von Steuerschränken sind von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mündlich, schriftlich) Affinität zu Computern (Messequipment, diverse Softwaretools, Dokumentation erstellen und pflegen) Gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie kundenorientiertes Denken und professioneller Umgang mit Kunden Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.
