descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our collaborative team for a 12 months internship in Zürich-Altstetten and gain hands-on experience in a global industrial environment. You will support a highly skilled Planning & Fulfillment team within our Insulation & Components product group, a worldwide leader in high-voltage transformer bushings. In this role, you contribute to essential operational processes while building strong analytical and organizational capabilities. You will learn how international supply chains operate and how data drives decision-making. You grow through close guidance, meaningful tasks, and an encouraging team culture. This role is ideal for someone curious, detail-oriented, and eager to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Support the Planning & Fulfillment team with administrative tasks Prepare and maintain regular reports and data analyses Help ensure data accuracy across planning systems Collaborate with internal stakeholders across departments Support continuous improvement initiatives within the team Contribute ideas to optimize reporting and workflows Your background Basic commercial education First experience in an administrative or office role Strong communication skills and team spirit Structured and detail-oriented working style Good knowledge of MS Office tools Fluent in German and English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems. As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us • We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Zur Verstärkung unserer Front-End-Sales-Organisation suchen wir einen Head of Bid & Proposal, der eine zentrale Rolle im Verkaufsteam Schweiz übernimmt. In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bid-&-Proposal- sowie Order-Handling-Teams mit klarer Ausrichtung auf Wachstum und Geschäftsergebnisse im Einklang mit der Hitachi-Energy-Strategie Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen, Strukturen und Prozessen zur Sicherstellung eines leistungsfähigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams Gesamtverantwortung für Angebotsprozesse und Auftragsabwicklung im Produktgeschäft für den Schweizer Markt – termingerecht, qualitäts- und kundengerecht Sicherstellung der fristgerechten, korrekten und regelkonformen Angebotsabgabe gemäss Kunden-, Vertrags- und internen • Anforderungen Entwicklung und Steuerung von Angebotsstrategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal sowie den Werken Aktive Gestaltung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktion sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Angebotsmanagement‑Prozesse Vorleben der Hitachi-Energy-Werte, insbesondere Sicherheit und Integrität Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor\/Master) im technischen oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich; betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation von Vorteil Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Bid & Proposal oder Projektmanagement Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder‑Strukturen Branchenkenntnisse im Energiesektor sowie ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung Tiefes Verständnis von Ausschreibungs‑ und Auftragsabwicklungsprozessen, inkl. SAP‑Grundlagen, kaufmännischer Abläufe, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risiko‑ sowie Claims‑Management Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, Team-Player Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, engagierten und kollaborativen Umfeld Klare Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch strukturierte Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt Eine einzigartige Kultur: Bringen Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihre Ideen ein und gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. Hybrid‑ und Remote‑Optionen Attraktives, wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs‑ und Leistungspaket

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As high voltage lab engineer , you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology to be used in high voltage products. In this position, you can test innovative ideas, implement new measurement and diagnostics methods, while you maintain a functional and safe testing environment . Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology and work towards a sustainable and exciting future in energy. How you will make an impact: Run and maintain state-of-the-art high voltage labs Participate actively in planning, preparation and execution of high voltage tests Collaborate closely with a team of scientists and technicians from research Bring your active contribution to the definition of safe testing practices in the lab during all phases of the experiments with the support of local HSE partners and research team Interact with partners in the adjacent Hitachi Energy high voltage labs and business units. W hat you will bring: Education in electrical engineering with at least a bachelor degree (FH) Proven experience in lab work, including experimental setup with advanced measurement methods Knowledge of lab integrated programming using LabView, Matlab or Python is very much welcome Skills in data analysis are a plus. Past experience in high voltage lab is advantageous . Conversational level in English is required, good knowledge of German language is very appreciated. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

descriptions.it: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided) You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers Your background PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The Opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy! Join us as a Scientist in Reliability Engineering and become part of a passionate, dynamic, and innovative team driving the energy transition. We are seeking a skilled and motivated scientist to strengthen our research in the reliability of power grid components and systems. In this role, you will bridge theory and application—developing and validating cutting-edge methods and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future. How you'll make an impact Drive innovation in reliability analysis, reliability improvement, and prognostics & health management for power grid components and systems Apply advanced techniques by combining reliability engineering, physics-of-failure insights, data analysis, mathematical modelling, and system tools to enhance the reliability of mission-critical equipment Collaborate globally with researchers and engineers across Hitachi Energy Research and business units to solve real-world challenges and identify opportunities for improvement Build strong networks within the company and with external partners, including universities, start-ups, and vendors Share your knowledge through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Solid experience in one or more of the following areas is required: statistical and probabilistic modelling (e.g., Bayesian inference, Monte Carlo simulations), mathematical modelling and simulation (e.g., Markov chains, Poisson processes, Petri nets), data science and machine learning Familiarity with reliability engineering methods or condition health monitoring in domains such as mechanical or electronics is a strong plus Proven track record of scientific publications in top-tier journals and conferences Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In this role, you will take a key position at the heart of our project organization, driving excellence across a diverse project portfolio within Hitachi Energy. As Project Management Portfolio Manager, you will shape and continuously improve our project execution strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices. You will lead and develop a high-performing PMO team, while partnering closely with senior stakeholders, Project Managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects successfully. By combining strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, you will strengthen our project management framework, support critical business decisions, and enable sustainable growth. This is a unique opportunity to make a visible impact on both operational performance and organizational development, while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability. How you'll make an impact Contribute to implement continuous improvements for the project execution strategy for the local project operation, in alignment with BU and GPG business strategies Develop and continuously improve processes based on industry's best practices. Ensure that findings from lessons learned from project execution are incorporated in continuous improvement actions Participate in bid or sales phase which involves activities such as estimating and resource planning Oversee project management activities at the portfolio level through project reviews with the management team and Project Managers Oversee the proper application of contract and claim management methods in accordance with Hitachi Energy's policies, and contractual agreements Lead the PMO team to establish and enforce an effective project management approach to achieve both project and organizational goals Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders of the PMO Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Master or Bachelor in the field of engineering or economics Min. 5 years extensive Project Management experience with EPC component as well as in the electrical field Deep knowledge about taking full ownership of the execution of complex projects and financial reporting Proven track record of extensive leadership experience with staff responsibility English proficiency is required, additional language skills are meritorious Experience in transmission and distribution industry from advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

descriptions.it: Descrizione - L'opportunità Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. - In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. - Il tuo ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. - Questa è la vostra opportunità di modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi in termini di stabilità, uptime e prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprieta', prospera in un ambiente frenetico e si diverte a fare un vero impatto? Allora applica oggi! Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito Requisiti - Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. - Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. - Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (attuazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). - Pianificazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. - Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. - Obblighi di invio nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di invio) concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione - The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. - As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. - Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. - This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. - Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! ## Mansioni - Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience - Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) - Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis - Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography - Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred - Good English and German language skills - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment ## Requisiti - Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. - Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. - Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). - Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. - Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. - Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. - On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. ## Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Beschreibung - Die Chance Fügen Sie einem hochkarätigen Photolithographie-Team bei, wo Ihr Know-how wirklich einen Einfluss hat. - Als Senior Photolithography Engineer sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Photolithographieprozessen verantwortlich, die in der Halbleiterfertigung verwendet werden. - Ihre Rolle wird die Zusammenarbeit mit fortschrittlichen Lithographie-Ausrüstungen, die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und die Gewährleistung hochwertiger Produktionsstandards beinhalten. - Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, technische Entscheidungen zu formen, zu langfristigen Werkzeugstrategien beizutragen und sinnvolle Verbesserungen in der Stabilität, der Standzeit und der Prozessleistung zu erreichen. - Sind Sie jemand, der Eigentümer nimmt, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung lebt und genießt eine echte Wirkung? Dann bewerben Sie sich heute! Mansion - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z.B. Elektro, Mechanisch, Chemie, Materialwissenschaft oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung - Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Wafer-Photolithographie, vor allem bei der Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Produktionsumgebung (Din-Film-Kopf, Halbleiterwafer-Herstellung) - Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Waferfabrik-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Experience mit Datenextraktion, Manipulation und Analyse - Starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie - Kenntnisse in der Datenwissenschaft und -programmierung werden bevorzugt - Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse - Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten Voraussetzungen - Mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialherstellern neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um ein reibungsloses Funktionieren der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. - Entwicklung neuer Techniken, Änderung bestehender Designs und Koordinierung von Prozessverbesserungsprojekten. - Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu identifizieren, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (implementieren und regelmäßig überprüfen SPC). - Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie. - Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzung, Diffusion, Metalle, Trockenätze und Implantat-Teams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten. - Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, um CD und Overlay zu messen. - An Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie von der Produktion verlangt) mit Teilnahme an der On-Call-Sitzung (vor dem On-Call-Demand) vereinbarte die Eigenverantwortung der anderen On-Call-Dienstleister. Cosa offriamo - Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione - L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. - En tant qu'ingénieur principal de photolithographie, vous serez chargé de développer et d'optimiser les processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. - Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. - C'est l'occasion de façonner les décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'améliorer significativement la stabilité, le temps d'attente et la performance des processus. - Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Mansioni - Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou doctorat avec expérience de l'industrie - Expérience approfondie dans les opérations de photolithographie des wafers, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition dans les Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication des wafers (fabrication des wafers à feuilles minces et à semi-conducteurs) - Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données - Forte compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion - La compétence en science des données et en programmation est préférée - Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre Requisiti - S'engager avec les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. - Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. - Analyser les données du processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). - Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'éther humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'éther sec et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. - Supporte certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire pour mesurer CD et Overlay. - Les services de garde les week-ends et jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres prestataires de services de garde. Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: In qualità di ingegnere del servizio sul campo presso HITACHI ENERGY LTD siete responsabili per l'installazione, la manutenzione e la riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente al cliente in Svizzera. Garantisci le prestazioni e la disponibilità ottimali dell'attrezzatura e contribuisci in modo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti. È possibile eseguire installazioni, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazioni su prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, soprattutto nelle aree di alta tensione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Analisi degli errori e eliminazione di sistemi e sistemi elettrici complessi. Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni applicazione. Consulenza clienti per domande tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione. Formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione dei sistemi. Rispetto alle normative di sicurezza e agli standard di qualità. Pronto a viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero. Partecipazione ai servizi di standby al di fuori delle ore di lavoro regolari. Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze sui nuovi prodotti e tecnologie. Formazione tecnica completa (ad esempio elettricista, elettronico, automatico) o studi (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia energetica). Esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore del servizio o della manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore dell'energia. La conoscenza della tecnologia ad alta tensione, sistemi di commutazione e sistemi di controllo è vantaggiosa. Gestione sicura delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova. Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura (swiss tedesco di vantaggio), così come buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza francese è un vantaggio. Capacità di problem solving goffrato e pensiero analitico. Alto livello di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del cliente. Valido ID Categoria B del conducente. Volontà a orari di lavoro flessibili e attività di viaggio. Ulteriori informazioni su di noi • Offriamo emozionante e variegato • Compiti con un ampio spazio di progettazione e interessanti possibilità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e versatili, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un pacchetto attraente di servizi con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di catering, nonché un diritto di parlare quando si sceglie l'alloggio.
descriptions.en: As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the equipment and make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. You can do this by performing installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and elimination of complex electrical systems and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each application. Customer advice regarding technical questions and optimization options. Training of customer personnel in handling the systems. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Ready to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in standby services outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating the expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Complete technical training (e.g. electrician, electronic, automatic) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy technology). Multiannual professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical installations, ideally in the energy industry. Knowledge of high-voltage technology, switching systems and control systems is advantageous. Safe handling of measuring and testing equipment. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (swiss German of advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. French knowledge is a plus. Embossed problem solving capabilities and analytical thinking. High level of initiative, sense of responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driver's ID Category B. Willing to flexible working hours and travel activities. More about us • We offer exciting and varied • Tasks with a large design space and attractive training and development possibilities. You can expect interesting and versatile activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive package of services with fixed travel and catering packages as well as a right to speak when choosing accommodation.
descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns • Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche • Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.
descriptions.fr: En tant qu'ingénieur de terrain chez HITACHI ENERGY LTD, vous êtes responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance et de la réparation de nos produits et systèmes directement chez le client en Suisse. Vous assurez la performance et la disponibilité optimales de l'équipement et contribuez de manière significative à la satisfaction de nos clients. Vous pouvez le faire en effectuant des installations, la mise en service, l'entretien et la réparation de produits et systèmes HITACHI ENERGY, en particulier dans les domaines de la haute tension, de la transmission et de la distribution d'énergie. Analyse des erreurs et élimination des systèmes et systèmes électriques complexes. Création de rapports de service et de documents après chaque demande. Conseils clients concernant les questions techniques et les options d'optimisation. Formation du personnel client à la gestion des systèmes. Conformité aux normes de sécurité et de qualité. Prêt à voyager en Suisse et à l'étranger. Participation aux services de secours en dehors des heures de travail normales. Formation continue et mise à jour de l'expertise sur les nouveaux produits et technologies. Vos antécédents Formation technique complète (p. ex. électricien, électronique, automatique) ou études (p. ex. génie électrique, technologie énergétique). Expérience professionnelle pluriannuelle dans le domaine du service ou de l'entretien des installations électriques, idéalement dans l'industrie énergétique. La connaissance de la technologie à haute tension, des systèmes de commutation et des systèmes de commande est avantageuse. Manipulation sécuritaire de l'équipement de mesure et d'essai. Bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture (allemand suisse d'avantage), ainsi que bonne connaissance de l'anglais. Le savoir français est un plus. Capacités de résolution de problèmes et de réflexion analytique. Niveau élevé d'initiative, sens des responsabilités et orientation des clients. Catégorie B d'identification du conducteur valide. Plus sur nous • Nous offrons passionnant et varié • Tâches avec un grand espace de conception et des possibilités de formation et de développement attrayantes. Vous pouvez vous attendre à des activités et des projets intéressants et polyvalents, y compris des opérations offshore, une équipe bien établie et dynamique et une culture d'entreprise ouverte. De plus, vous bénéficiez d'un ensemble attrayant de services avec des forfaits de voyage et de restauration fixes ainsi que d'un droit de parole lors du choix de l'hébergement.
