descriptions.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Come Area Sales Manager, prenderete la proprietà di guidare la crescita aziendale all'interno della vostra regione assegnata e plasmare attivamente il nostro successo di mercato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e partner, posizionando il nostro portafoglio all'avanguardia e fornendo soluzioni che soddisfano requisiti tecnici e commerciali complessi. Entrando nel nostro team internazionale e altamente esperto, si acquisirà approfondimenti nel business ad alta tensione, contribuendo direttamente ai sistemi energetici sostenibili e affidabili. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per coniugare competenze tecniche con responsabilità commerciale e per dare un impatto tangibile sul futuro dell'energia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita per la tua regione assegnata, guidare la crescita sostenibile del business e aumentare la quota di mercato all'interno del portafoglio GIS - Costruire, mantenere ed espandere relazioni forti con i clienti chiave, gli EPC e i partner per identificare le opportunità di business e creare valore a lungo termine - Prendere la proprietà del ciclo di vendita completo, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e offrire la preparazione alla negoziazione e la chiusura di accordi di successo - Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne come l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto e i team di assistenza per fornire soluzioni competitive e orientate al cliente - Analizzare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività concorrenti per posizionare in modo proattivo il nostro portafoglio e rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato - Incremento dell'ordine e crescita dei ricavi, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità strategiche - Sostenere i clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei progetti, assicurando un alto livello di soddisfazione e individuando opportunità per ulteriori affari Il tuo sfondo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nelle vendite tecniche, gestione del conto chiave, o un ruolo simile rispetto al cliente, idealmente all'interno del settore energetico o industriale - Laurea (Bachelor o Master) in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo tecnico correlato, completato da una forte comprensione commerciale - Provato track record nella vendita di prodotti o sistemi tecnici complessi, con la capacità di gestire il ciclo di vendita completo e chiudere con successo le offerte - Esperienza di lavoro con i clienti attraverso diversi livelli e funzioni, tra cui la capacità di costruire la fiducia, influenzare le decisioni e gestire i negoziati impegnativi - una forte comprensione del mercato dell'energia, dell'industria manifatturiera o del business del sistema, idealmente con l'esposizione a sottostazioni o tecnologie di commutazione - Mindset Entrepreneurial con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, combinato con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e guidare argomenti in avanti - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con una mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team internazionali e interfunzionali - Volontà al viaggio (circa il 20%) Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. As an Area Sales Manager, you will take ownership of driving business growth within your assigned region and actively shape our market success. You will work closely with customers and partners, positioning our cutting-edge portfolio and delivering solutions that meet complex technical and commercial requirements. Joining our international and highly experienced team, you will gain deep insights into the high-voltage business while contributing directly to sustainable and reliable energy systems. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise with commercial responsibility and to make a tangible impact on the future of energy. ## How you'll make an impact - Develop and execute sales strategies for your assigned region, driving sustainable business growth and increasing market share within the GIS portfolio - Build, maintain, and expand strong relationships with key customers, EPCs, and partners to identify business opportunities and create long-term value - Take ownership of the full sales cycle, from opportunity identification and offer preparation to negotiation and successful deal closure - Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders such as engineering, project management, and service teams to deliver competitive and customer-oriented solutions - Analyse market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to proactively position our portfolio and strengthen our market presence - Drive order intake and revenue growth while ensuring alignment with business targets and strategic priorities - Support customers throughout the lifecycle of projects, ensuring a high level of satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further business ## Your background - Minimum 5 years of professional experience in technical sales, key account management, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within the energy or industrial sector - Degree (Bachelor or Master) in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related technical field, complemented by a strong commercial understanding - Proven track record in selling complex technical products or systems, with the ability to manage the full sales cycle and successfully close deals - Experience working with customers across different levels and functions, including the ability to build trust, influence decisions, and manage challenging negotiations - Strong understanding of the energy market, manufacturing industry, or system business, ideally with exposure to substations or switchgear technologies - Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach, combined with the ability to work independently and drive topics forward - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams - Willingness to travel (approx. 20%) ## More about us - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Descrizion Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, ist weltweit als Spezialist für Energieübertragung und -verteilung bekannt. Unsere Einheit Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon ist in der Entwicklung und Produktion von gasisolierten Schaltsystemen tätig. Wir gewährleisten die hohe Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme durch den Einsatz modernster Entwicklungswerkzeuge und -methoden. Als Area Sales Manager übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung, das Geschäftswachstum in Ihrer zugewiesenen Region voranzutreiben und unseren Markterfolg aktiv zu gestalten. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kunden und Partnern zusammen, positionieren unser hochmodernes Portfolio und liefern Lösungen, die komplexe technische und kommerzielle Anforderungen erfüllen. In unserem internationalen und sehr erfahrenen Team erhalten Sie tiefe Einblicke in das Hochvoltgeschäft und tragen direkt zu nachhaltigen und zuverlässigen Energiesystemen bei. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, technisches Know-how mit wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung zu verbinden und die Zukunft der Energie spürbar zu beeinflussen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden - Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien für Ihre zugewiesene Region, Förderung eines nachhaltigen Geschäftswachstums und Steigerung des Marktanteils innerhalb des GIS-Portfolios Aufbau, Pflege und Ausbau starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden, EPCs und Partnern, um Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und langfristigen Wert zu schaffen Übernehmen Sie den gesamten Verkaufszyklus, von der Gelegenheitsidentifikation und Angebotsvorbereitung bis hin zu Verhandlungen und erfolgreichem Abschluss Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern wie Engineering, Projektmanagement und Serviceteams, um wettbewerbsfähige und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu liefern - Analyse von Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnissen und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um unser Portfolio proaktiv zu positionieren und unsere Marktpräsenz zu stärken - Steigerung des Auftragseingangs und des Umsatzwachstums bei gleichzeitiger Ausrichtung auf Geschäftsziele und strategische Prioritäten - Kunden während des gesamten Lebenszyklus von Projekten unterstützen, ein hohes Maß an Zufriedenheit sicherstellen und Möglichkeiten für weitere Geschäfte identifizieren Dein Hintergrund - Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Key Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Energie- oder Industriesektor - Abschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich, ergänzt durch ein starkes kaufmännisches Verständnis - Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz beim Verkauf komplexer technischer Produkte oder Systeme mit der Fähigkeit, den gesamten Verkaufszyklus zu verwalten und Geschäfte erfolgreich abzuschließen - Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden auf verschiedenen Ebenen und Funktionen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Entscheidungen zu beeinflussen und herausfordernde Verhandlungen zu führen - Starkes Verständnis des Energiemarktes, der verarbeitenden Industrie oder des Systemgeschäfts, idealerweise mit Umspannwerken oder Schaltanlagentechnologien - Unternehmerisches Mindset mit proaktivem und lösungsorientiertem Ansatz, kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Themen voranzutreiben - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit einer kollaborativen Denkweise und der Fähigkeit, effektiv in internationalen und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten - Reisebereitschaft (ca. 20%) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation isothermes. Nous assurons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. En tant que directeur des ventes de la région, vous allez prendre en charge la croissance des affaires dans votre région et façonner activement notre succès sur le marché. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les partenaires, en positionnant notre portefeuille de pointe et en proposant des solutions répondant à des exigences techniques et commerciales complexes. En vous joignant à notre équipe internationale et hautement expérimentée, vous aurez une connaissance approfondie de l'activité à haute tension tout en contribuant directement à des systèmes énergétiques durables et fiables. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique de combiner expertise technique et responsabilité commerciale et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir de l'énergie. Comment vous ferez un impact - Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de vente pour votre région, en stimulant la croissance durable des entreprises et en augmentant la part de marché au sein du portefeuille SIG - Établir, maintenir et élargir des relations solides avec les principaux clients, EPC et partenaires afin de cerner les possibilités d'affaires et de créer une valeur à long terme - S'approprier le cycle complet des ventes, de l'identification des opportunités et de l'offre de préparation à la négociation et la conclusion réussie de l'accord - Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes tels que l'ingénierie, la gestion de projet et les équipes de service pour offrir des solutions compétitives et axées sur le client - Analyser les tendances du marché, les besoins des clients et les activités des concurrents pour positionner notre portefeuille de manière proactive et renforcer notre présence sur le marché - Favoriser la prise de commandes et la croissance des recettes tout en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs opérationnels et les priorités stratégiques - Soutenir les clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, en assurant un haut niveau de satisfaction et en identifiant les opportunités de nouvelles affaires Vos antécédents - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les ventes techniques, la gestion des comptes clés ou un rôle similaire pour le client, idéalement dans le secteur énergétique ou industriel - Diplôme (Bachelor ou Master) en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine technique connexe, complété par une solide compréhension commerciale - Expérience éprouvée dans la vente de produits ou de systèmes techniques complexes, avec la capacité de gérer le cycle de vente complet et de conclure des contrats avec succès - Expérience de travail avec les clients à différents niveaux et fonctions, y compris la capacité de renforcer la confiance, d'influencer les décisions et de gérer les négociations difficiles - Une bonne compréhension du marché de l'énergie, de l'industrie manufacturière ou du secteur des systèmes, idéalement avec une exposition aux sous-stations ou aux technologies de commutation - L'esprit d'entreprise avec une approche proactive et orientée vers la solution, combinée avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et de faire avancer les sujets - Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, avec une mentalité collaborative et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans des équipes internationales et interfonctionnelles - Volonté de voyager (environ 20%) Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: Mansioni Unisciti al nostro team IT e media collaborativo e contribuisci a modellare le esperienze degli eventi digitali. In questo ruolo, supporti lo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative per il monitoraggio dei media e degli eventi, lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti nell'ingegneria del software e nella modellazione dei dati. Progetta e implementa un sistema strutturato che migliora la trasparenza e genera preziose informazioni operative. Attraverso vere sfide aziendali, si rafforzano le vostre competenze tecniche e analitiche. Con una mentorship dedicata e un ambiente favorevole e inclusivo, puoi crescere e sviluppare continuamente il tuo potenziale. - Analizzare gli strumenti esistenti e identificare le incongruenze dei dati e le lacune di segnalazione - Definire requisiti funzionali e non funzionali per una soluzione di tracciamento - Progettare un modello di dati strutturato e scalabile per il monitoraggio delle operazioni - Sviluppare una soluzione digitale che supporta i flussi di lavoro dei media e degli eventi - Implementare calcoli automatizzati di evitamento dei costi con logica chiara - Crea cruscotti e report per informazioni operative - convalidare la soluzione utilizzando dati operativi reali - Risultati dei documenti e potenziale di miglioramento basato sui risultati Requisiti Il tuo sfondo - Iscritti in Software e Ingegneria Informatica di Bachelor - Requisiti obbligatori di stage all'interno del programma di studio - Conoscenza dei principi di progettazione e modellazione dei dati - Esperienza con concetti di programmazione e database - pensiero analitico e capacità di problem solving strutturate - Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese Cosa? Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Siamo un'azienda tecnologica con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile. - Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. - Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. - Cittadini non UE/EFTA, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che un tirocinio è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.
descriptions.en: ## Mansioni Join our collaborative IT and media team and contribute to shaping digital event experiences. In this role, you support the development of innovative solutions for media and event operations tracking while working closely with experts in software engineering and data modeling. You design and implement a structured system that improves transparency and generates valuable operational insights. Through real business challenges, you strengthen your technical and analytical skills. With dedicated mentorship and a supportive, inclusive environment, you can continuously grow and develop your potential. - Analyze existing tools and identify data inconsistencies and reporting gaps - Define functional and non functional requirements for a tracking solution - Design a structured and scalable data model for operations tracking - Develop a digital solution supporting media and event workflows - Implement automated cost avoidance calculations with clear logic - Create dashboards and reporting views for operational insights - Validate the solution using real operational data - Document results and improvement potential based on findings ## Requisiti Your background - Enrolled in Bachelor Informatics Software and Information Engineering - Mandatory internship requirement within study program - Knowledge of software design and data modeling principles - Experience with programming and database concepts - Analytical thinking and structured problem solving skills - Strong communication skills in English ## Cosa offriamo More about us - We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. - We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. - We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. - Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptions.de: Mansioni Treten Sie unserem kollaborativen IT- und Medienteam bei und tragen Sie zur Gestaltung digitaler Eventerlebnisse bei. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für das Medien- und Event Operations Tracking und arbeiten eng mit Experten für Software Engineering und Datenmodellierung zusammen. Sie entwerfen und implementieren ein strukturiertes System, das die Transparenz verbessert und wertvolle operative Erkenntnisse generiert. Durch echte geschäftliche Herausforderungen stärken Sie Ihre technischen und analytischen Fähigkeiten. Mit engagierter Mentorschaft und einer unterstützenden, integrativen Umgebung können Sie kontinuierlich wachsen und Ihr Potenzial entwickeln. - Analysieren Sie vorhandene Tools und identifizieren Sie Dateninkonsistenzen und Berichtslücken - Definieren funktionaler und nicht funktionaler Anforderungen an eine Tracking-Lösung - Entwerfen eines strukturierten und skalierbaren Datenmodells für die Betriebsverfolgung - Entwicklung einer digitalen Lösung, die Medien- und Event-Workflows unterstützt - Implementieren Sie automatisierte Kostenvermeidungsberechnungen mit klarer Logik - Erstellen von Dashboards und Berichtsansichten für operative Einblicke - Validierung der Lösung mithilfe realer Betriebsdaten - Ergebnisse und Verbesserungspotenzial basierend auf Erkenntnissen dokumentieren Requisiti Dein Hintergrund - Eingeschrieben in Bachelor Informatik Software und Information Engineering - Pflichtpraktikumspflicht im Studienprogramm - Kenntnisse des Softwaredesigns und der Prinzipien der Datenmodellierung - Erfahrung mit Programmier- und Datenbankkonzepten Analytisches Denken und strukturierte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten - Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch Cosa offriamo Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. - Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und befähigen Sie, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. - Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. - Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat, das zeigt, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist, erforderlich ist.
descriptions.fr: Mansioni Rejoignez notre équipe collaborative IT et médias et contribuez à façonner les expériences d'événements numériques. Dans ce rôle, vous soutenez le développement de solutions innovantes pour le suivi des opérations de médias et d'événements tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des experts en ingénierie logicielle et en modélisation des données. Vous concevez et implémentez un système structuré qui améliore la transparence et génère des informations opérationnelles précieuses. Grâce à de véritables défis commerciaux, vous renforcez vos compétences techniques et analytiques. Avec un mentorat dévoué et un environnement favorable et inclusif, vous pouvez continuellement développer et développer votre potentiel. - Analyser les outils existants et identifier les incohérences dans les données et les lacunes dans les rapports - Définir les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles pour une solution de suivi - Concevoir un modèle de données structuré et évolutif pour le suivi des opérations - Développer une solution numérique supportant les flux de travail des médias et des événements - Mettre en œuvre des calculs automatisés d'évitement des coûts avec une logique claire - Créer des tableaux de bord et des points de vue pour les informations opérationnelles - Valider la solution en utilisant des données opérationnelles réelles - Documenter les résultats et le potentiel d'amélioration sur la base des résultats Requisiti Vos antécédents - Engagé dans les logiciels de baccalauréat informatique et de génie de l'information - Exigences de stage obligatoires dans le cadre du programme d'études - Connaissance des principes de conception des logiciels et de modélisation des données - Expérience des concepts de programmation et de base de données - Réflexion analytique et compétences structurées en résolution de problèmes - Fortes compétences en communication en anglais Cosa offriamo Plus sur nous - Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie avec un fort accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. - Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement de soutien et d'inclusion où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. - Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. - Citoyens non-UE/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel montrant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Business Unit Service is at the forefront of delivering advanced, reliability-driven service solutions worldwide. As we evolve from descriptive monitoring toward scalable predictive and prescriptive intelligence, reliability modelling becomes a cornerstone of how we create customer value across the asset lifecycle. As Senior Reliability Specialist, you will take an enterprise level role in shaping how reliability intelligence is defined, governed, and applied across our global digital service portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of reliability engineering, digital platforms, and service strategy, ensuring that reliability models are scientifically robust, consistently governed, scalable, and reusable—while being directly connected to operational performance and commercial outcomes. This is a senior, high impact role for an expert who wants to influence how reliability intelligence is used across an entire organization, not just within a single product or project. How you'll make an impact Define and implement the enterprise reliability modelling strategy across BU Service Ensure reliability models deliver consistent, explainable, and decision relevant outputs (e.g., PoF, RUL, risk, mitigation) used in customer facing and decision critical contexts Coordinate companywide projects and activities to harmonize reliability methods and avoid duplication Govern reliability model development, validation, deployment, and retirement Drive integration of reliability models into digital service and predictive platforms Partner with digital, analytics, and IT\/OT teams on data driven reliability solutions Establish standards, guidelines, and training programs for reliability engineering Define and track KPIs and deliver executive insights on reliability performance and maturity Your background Master's or PhD degree in Engineering (Reliability, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or related) Proven experience in reliability engineering and reliability modelling in mission‑critical environments Strong expertise in failure analysis, reliability modelling, and asset health management methods Experience coordinating or governing technical or modelling activities across multiple teams or units Confidence to work effectively in complex IT\/OT environments with multiple stakeholders Ability to translate reliability insights into operational decisions and service performance outcomes More about us • We offer a highly collaborative environment across engineering, digital, analytics, and service teams A senior, visible role shaping the future of reliability intelligence in global digital services Continuous learning through exposure to leading reliability, predictive, and digital service practices Flexible working practices that help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di OSS collaborativo e supporta le operazioni IT quotidiane vicino al business. Garantisci ai dipendenti di avere dispositivi affidabili e un'esperienza di lavoro digitale fluida. In questo ruolo pratico, impari come risolvere problemi tecnici e preparare attrezzature IT essenziali. Si lavora a stretto contatto con gli utenti finali e ottenere preziose informazioni su come l'IT guida la produttività. Durante i 12 mesi di stage, colleghi esperti sostengono la vostra crescita e sviluppo. Come farete un impatto Assist nella risoluzione dei problemi IT di base, nel ripristino dei computer portatili e di altri dispositivi in modo che siano pronti per l'uso da parte di dipendenti nuovi o esistenti Supporta gli utenti finali nella navigazione di strumenti di self-service e procedure IT standard Assistere con la gestione delle scorte, il recupero degli asset\/ritorno e la preparazione dei dispositivi per i problemi di bordo\/offboarding Processi di garanzia di supporto raccogliendo informazioni e preparando i dispositivi IT Essere impegnato in progetti speciali in cui si effettua l'impatto (locazione, cambiamento dell'assetto dell'ufficio, istituire infrastrutture, impostare le sale riunioni) Essere impegnato in progetti speciali sul sito, come rilocali per uffici, modifiche ai layout per uffici, installazione delle infrastrutture, preparazione o riconfigurazione delle sale riunioni, contribuendo direttamente a come funziona il luogo di lavoro Attualmente studiando presso una scuola universitaria o tecnica (EFZ) in IT, informatica, ingegneria o un campo correlato Lavorare con le persone e con le seguenti procedure consolidate e si è appassionati di rendere le cose migliori La comprensione di base dell'hardware e dei sistemi operativi Eager per imparare e sviluppare competenze tecniche in una mani ‐ su ambiente Forte problema ‐ risolvere mindset e buona attenzione ai dettagli Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco Più su di noi Siamo una società di sviluppo continuo con un forte focus • Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How you'll make an impact Assist in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users in navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help maintain IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems operate correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team. Be engaged in special projects where you make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up, set up infrastructure, set-up of the meeting rooms) Be engaged in special on ‑ site projects, such as office relocations, changes to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people and with following established procedures and you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptions.de: Treten Sie unserem kollaborativen OSS-Team bei und unterstützen Sie den täglichen IT-Betrieb in der Nähe des Unternehmens. Sie stellen sicher, dass Mitarbeiter über zuverlässige Geräte und ein reibungsloses digitales Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verfügen. In dieser praktischen Rolle lernen Sie, wie Sie technische Probleme beheben und wichtige IT-Geräte vorbereiten können. Sie arbeiten eng mit Endbenutzern zusammen und gewinnen wertvolle Erkenntnisse darüber, wie IT die Produktivität antreibt. Während des 12-monatigen Praktikums unterstützen erfahrene Kollegen Ihr Wachstum und Ihre Entwicklung. Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen Assist bei der Fehlersuche grundlegende IT-Probleme, p repare Laptops und andere Geräte, so dass sie bereit sind für den Einsatz durch neue oder bestehende Mitarbeiter Unterstützung Endbenutzer bei der Navigation Self-Service-Tools und Standard-IT-Prozeduren Assist bei der Bestandsabwicklung, Asset Pickup / Return und Gerätevorbereitung für Onboarding Support Garantieprozesse durch das Sammeln von Informationen und Vorbereitung von Geräten Hilfe bei der Wartung IT-Ausrüstung in Besprechungsräumen und gemeinsam genutzten Büroräumen, um sicherzustellen, dass Systeme korrekt funktionieren Aktualisieren Sie die Dokumentation in Bezug auf Gerätevorbereitung und OSS-Verfahren und melden Sie Probleme an das Team. Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten, bei denen Sie etwas bewirken (Umzug, Änderung der Büroeinrichtung, Einrichtung der Infrastruktur, Einrichtung der Besprechungsräume) Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten vor Ort, wie Büroverlagerungen, Änderungen an Bürolayouts, Infrastruktureinrichtung und Vorbereitung oder Neukonfiguration von Besprechungsräumen, die direkt dazu beitragen, wie der Arbeitsplatz funktioniert Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit studieren an einer Universität oder technischen Schule (EFZ) in IT, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich Komfortable Arbeit mit Menschen und mit den folgenden etablierten Verfahren und Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Dinge besser Grundlegendes Verständnis von Computer-Hardware und Betriebssystemen Eager zu lernen und zu entwickeln technische Fähigkeiten in einer Hand - auf Umwelt Starke Problemlösung Denkweise und gute Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre équipe collaborative OSS et soutenez des opérations informatiques quotidiennes proches de l'entreprise. Vous vous assurez que les employés ont des appareils fiables et une expérience de travail numérique en douceur. Dans ce rôle pratique, vous apprenez comment résoudre les problèmes techniques et préparer les équipements informatiques essentiels. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs finaux et obtenez des informations précieuses sur la façon dont l'informatique stimule la productivité. Pendant les 12 mois de stage, des collègues expérimentés soutiennent votre croissance et votre développement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Aider à résoudre les problèmes informatiques de base, à remplacer les ordinateurs portables et autres appareils afin qu'ils soient prêts à être utilisés par des employés nouveaux ou existants Aider les utilisateurs finaux à naviguer des outils d'auto-service et des procédures informatiques standard Aider à la manutention des stocks, à la récupération d'actifs et au retour, et à la préparation des appareils pour les processus de garantie à bord et hors-bord Soutenir les processus de garantie en recueillant de l'information et en préparant des appareils Aider à maintenir l'équipement de TI dans les salles de réunion et les bureaux partagés, en veillant à ce que les systèmes fonctionnent correctement Mettre à jour la documentation relative à la préparation des appareils et aux procédures SSO et signaler les problèmes à l'équipe. S'engager dans des projets spéciaux où vous faites impact (relocalisation, changement d'agencement, mise en place d'infrastructures, mise en place des salles de réunion) S'engager dans des projets spéciaux sur le site, tels que des déménagements de bureaux, des modifications à la disposition des bureaux, la configuration de l'infrastructure et la préparation ou la reconfiguration des salles de réunion, contribuant directement au fonctionnement du lieu de travail Votre expérience Vous étudiez actuellement dans une université ou une école technique (EFZ) en informatique, en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe Travaillant confortablement avec les gens et en suivant les procédures établies et vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration de la compréhension de base du matériel informatique et des systèmes d'exploitation Evidemment apprendre et développer des compétences techniques dans un environnement ‐ sur l'environnement Problème fort ‐ résoudre l'état d'esprit et une bonne attention aux détails Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et fortement axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. • Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione dell'agenda di trasformazione digitale e miglioramento continuo all'interno del GCB. In qualità di responsabile del progetto di miglioramento – Data & Digital Analytics, lavorerai all'incrocio tra business, dati e tecnologia, guidando iniziative basate sui dati che migliorano l'efficienza operativa, la trasparenza e la qualità decisionale. Potrai progettare e fornire soluzioni digitali e analytics scalabili utilizzando le moderne tecnologie cloud, consentendo KPI standardizzati, insight affidabili e automazione sostenibile. Collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT, contribuirai direttamente a migliorare le prestazioni misurabili e sostenere la maturità digitale a lungo termine dell'organizzazione. Condurre progetti di miglioramento digitale e continuo da concept a rollout e stabilizzazione Definire l'ambito di progetto, le pietre miliari, i KPI, i criteri di governance e di successo allineati alle priorità aziendali Assicurare la disponibilità dei dati, la qualità, la coerenza e l'utilizzo conforme in GCB Design e implementare soluzioni di analisi e elaborazione dati basate su cloud. Corso di laurea o master in informatica, ingegneria, o un campo STEM correlati 2- 3 anni esperienza lavorativa rilevante Forte ingegneria dei dati e competenze di analisi (SQL, database relazionali, analisi cloud, Databricks) Solida comprensione dei dati SAP S\/4HANA Esperienza con Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Un'eccellente gestione del progetto, la proprietà e l'esecuzione focalizzano la collaborazione, la proattiva e l'autodidatta con la passione per l'innovazione digitale e il miglioramento continuo. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity This role offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the digital transformation and continuous improvement agenda within GCB. As Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, driving data driven initiatives that improve operational efficiency, transparency, and decision-making quality. You will design and deliver scalable digital and analytics solutions using modern cloud technologies, enabling standardized KPIs, reliable insights, and sustainable automation. By collaborating closely with business and IT stakeholders, you will directly contribute to measurable performance improvements and support the organization's long-term digital maturity. How you'll make an impact Lead digital and continuous improvement projects from concept to rollout and stabilization Define project scope, milestones, KPIs, governance, and success criteria aligned with business priorities Ensure data availability, quality, consistency, and compliant usage across GCB Design and implement cloud based analytics and data processing solutions Work extensively with Databricks for data ingestion, transformation, analysis, and modeling Identify process inefficiencies and implement automation to reduce manual effort and cycle times Enable standardized KPIs and transparent reporting for management decision-making Proactively manage risks, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder expectations Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related STEM field 2- 3 years relevant working experience Strong data engineering and analytics skills (SQL, relational databases, cloud analytics, Databricks) Solid understanding of SAP S\/4HANA data Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Proven track record delivering digitalization, process automation, and improvement initiatives Structured, analytical mindset with strong business communication skills Excellent project management, ownership, and execution focus Collaborative, proactive, and self-driven with a passion for digital innovation and continuous improvement Business fluent in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der Agenda für digitale Transformation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung innerhalb des GCB zu spielen. Als Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Business, Daten und Technologie und fördern datengetriebene Initiativen, die die betriebliche Effizienz, Transparenz und Entscheidungsqualität verbessern. Sie entwerfen und liefern skalierbare Digital- und Analyselösungen mit modernen Cloud-Technologien, die standardisierte KPIs, zuverlässige Erkenntnisse und nachhaltige Automatisierung ermöglichen. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern tragen Sie direkt zu messbaren Leistungsverbesserungen bei und unterstützen die langfristige digitale Reife des Unternehmens. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen Sie digitale und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprojekte vom Konzept bis zur Einführung und Stabilisierung Definieren Sie Projektumfang, Meilensteine, KPIs, Governance und Erfolgskriterien, die mit den Geschäftsprioritäten abgestimmt sind Sicherstellen Sie Datenverfügbarkeit, Qualität, Konsistenz und konforme Nutzung über GCB Design und implementieren Sie Cloud-basierte Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungslösungen Arbeiten Sie umfassend mit Databricks für Datenaufnahme, Transformation, Analyse und Modellierung Prozessineffizienzen identifizieren und implementieren Sie Automatisierung, um den manuellen Aufwand und die Zykluszeiten zu reduzieren Ermöglichen Sie standardisierte KPIs und transparentes Reporting für Managemententscheidungen Proaktiv verwalten Sie Risiken, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen und Erwartungen der Stakeholder Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten STEM-Bereich 2- 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung Starke Data Engineering- und Analysefähigkeiten (SQL, relationale Datenbanken, Cloud Analytics, Databricks) Solides Verständnis von SAP S\/4HANA-Daten Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung von Digitalisierungs-, Prozessautomatisierungs- und Verbesserungsinitiativen Strukturierte, analytische Denkweise mit starken Geschäftskommunikationsfähigkeiten Ausgezeichneter Projektmanagement-, Eigentümer- und Ausführungsfokus Kollaborative, proaktive und selbstgesteuerte mit einer Leidenschaft für digitale Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Business fließend Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Ce rôle offre la possibilité de jouer un rôle clé dans l'élaboration du programme de transformation numérique et d'amélioration continue au sein du GCB. En tant que gestionnaire de projet d'amélioration – Data & Digital Analytics, vous travaillerez à l'intersection des activités, des données et de la technologie, en conduisant des initiatives axées sur les données qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle, la transparence et la qualité de la prise de décision. Vous concevrez et fournirez des solutions numériques et analytiques évolutives à l'aide de technologies cloud modernes, permettant des KPI standardisés, des informations fiables et une automatisation durable. En collaborant étroitement avec les intervenants en affaires et en TI, vous contribuerez directement à l'amélioration mesurable du rendement et à la maturité numérique à long terme de l'organisation. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger les projets d'amélioration numérique et continue du concept au déploiement et à la stabilisation Définir la portée du projet, les jalons, les ICR, la gouvernance et les critères de réussite conformes aux priorités opérationnelles Assurer la disponibilité, la qualité, l'uniformité et l'utilisation conforme des données dans l'ensemble du GCB Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des solutions d'analyse et de traitement des données basées sur le cloud Travailler en profondeur avec Databricks pour l'ingestion, la transformation, l'analyse et la modélisation des données Identifier les inefficacités des processus et mettre en oeuvre l'automatisation pour réduire l'effort manuel et les temps de cycle Permettre des ICR normalisés et des rapports transparents pour la prise de décisions en matière de gestion Gérer de façon proactive les risques, les dépendances, les ressources et les attentes des intervenants Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine STEM connexe 2- 3 ans d'expérience de travail pertinente Fortes compétences en ingénierie et en analyse des données (SQL, bases de données relationnelles, analyse du cloud, Databricks) Une bonne compréhension des données SAP S\/4HANA Expérience avec Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Expérience éprouvée en matière de numérisation, d'automatisation des processus et d'amélioration Initiatives structurées, analytiques et solides en matière de communication d'affaires Excellente gestion de projet, propriété et mise au point d'exécution Collaboration, proactivité et autodidacte avec une passion pour l'innovation numérique et l'amélioration continue Business couramment en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et commerciales tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Unisciti a Hitachi, Ltd. come ingegnere delle apparecchiature e gioca un ruolo chiave nell'ottimizzazione e nella manutenzione delle apparecchiature di produzione per garantire prestazioni elevate, affidabilità ed efficienza. Lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo e supportando processi produttivi innovativi. Come avrai un impatto Sviluppare e implementare modifiche e aggiornamenti alle apparecchiature di produzione esistenti per migliorare l'efficienza, la resa e la sicurezza Eseguire la manutenzione ordinaria, la risoluzione dei problemi e la riparazione di macchinari e sistemi di produzione complessi Analizzare i dati sulle prestazioni delle apparecchiature per identificare tendenze, prevedere guasti e implementare misure preventive Collaborare con i team di produzione, ricerca e sviluppo e qualità per risolvere problemi relativi alle apparecchiature e ottimizzare i processi Creare e conservare la documentazione per il funzionamento delle apparecchiature, le procedure di manutenzione e le specifiche tecniche Formare tecnici e operatori sulle nuove apparecchiature e sulle procedure aggiornate Gestire l'inventario dei pezzi di ricambio e garantire l'approvvigionamento tempestivo delle necessarie componenti e garantire la conformità agli standard di sicurezza e alle normative ambientali Supportare la selezione, l'installazione e la qualificazione di nuove apparecchiature di produzione Il tuo background Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o ingegneria elettrica Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria delle apparecchiature in un ambiente di produzione Forte conoscenza dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici e di controllo Comprovata capacità di risolvere i problemi di macchinari complessi e identificare le cause profonde dei guasti Familiarità con i principi della produzione snella e metodi di miglioramento continuo Forti capacità di analisi, risoluzione dei problemi e comunicazione Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente frenetico L'inglese è obbligatorio, il tedesco è vantaggioso More chi siamo Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes. As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment Your background Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment Experience in the Semiconductor field is highly desirable Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems is a plus (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment English is mandatory, German is beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Werden Sie bei Hitachi, Ltd. als Geräteingenieur tätig und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Optimierung und Wartung von Produktionsanlagen, um hohe Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz sicherzustellen. Sie arbeiten in einer kollaborativen Umgebung, tragen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bei und unterstützen innovative Fertigungsprozesse. Wie Sie etwas bewirken können: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Änderungen und Upgrades an vorhandenen Fertigungsanlagen, um Effizienz, Ertrag und Sicherheit zu verbessern. Führen Sie routinemäßige Wartungs-, Fehlerbehebungs- und Reparaturarbeiten an komplexen Fertigungsmaschinen und -systemen durch. Analysieren Sie Leistungsdaten der Anlagen, um Trends zu erkennen, Ausfälle vorherzusagen und vorbeugende Maßnahmen zu implementieren. Arbeiten Sie mit Produktions-, F&E- und Qualitätsteams zusammen, um anlagenbezogene Probleme zu lösen und Prozesse zu optimieren. Erstellen und pflegen Sie Dokumentationen für den Anlagenbetrieb, Wartungsverfahren und technische Spezifikationen Beschaffung der erforderlichen Komponenten und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards und Umweltvorschriften. Unterstützung bei der Auswahl, Installation und Qualifizierung neuer Fertigungsanlagen. Ihr Hintergrund. Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik. Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Anlagentechnik in einer Fertigungsumgebung. Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von mechanischen, elektrischen und Steuerungssystemen. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Maschinen zu beheben und Fehlerursachen zu identifizieren. Vertrautheit mit Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden. Starke Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu arbeiten. Englisch ist Pflicht, Deutsch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez Hitachi, Ltd. en tant qu'ingénieur d'équipement et jouez un rôle clé dans l'optimisation et la maintenance des équipements de fabrication afin de garantir des performances, une fiabilité et une efficacité élevées. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif, contribuant à l’amélioration continue et soutenant des processus de fabrication innovants. Comment vous aurez un impact Développer et mettre en œuvre des modifications et des mises à niveau des équipements de fabrication existants pour améliorer l'efficacité, le rendement et la sécurité Effectuer la maintenance de routine, le dépannage et la réparation de machines et de systèmes de fabrication complexes Analyser les données de performance des équipements pour identifier les tendances, prévoir les pannes et mettre en œuvre des mesures préventives Collaborer avec les équipes de production, de R&D et de qualité pour résoudre les problèmes liés aux équipements et optimiser les processus Créer et maintenir la documentation sur le fonctionnement des équipements, les procédures de maintenance et les spécifications techniques Former les techniciens et les opérateurs sur les nouveaux équipements et les procédures mises à jour Gérer l'inventaire des pièces de rechange et assurer l'approvisionnement en temps opportun des composants requis et assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et des réglementations environnementales Soutenir la sélection, l'installation et la qualification de nouveaux équipements de fabrication Votre formation Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou en génie électrique Minimum de 2 ans d'expérience en ingénierie d'équipement dans un environnement de fabrication Forte compréhension des systèmes mécaniques, électriques et de contrôle Capacité avérée à dépanner des machines complexes et à identifier les causes profondes des pannes Familiarité avec les principes de fabrication Lean et les méthodes d'amélioration continue Solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en communication Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe dans un environnement en évolution rapide L'anglais est obligatoire, l'allemand est bénéfique En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation, experience in robot handling is advantageous Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in English, German highly beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.fr: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. descriptions.it: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes.  This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Are you passionate about driving innovation and enhancing manufacturing processes? As an Equipment Engineer, you'll be at the heart of optimizing production systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and shaping the future of semiconductor technology. This role offers a dynamic environment where your ideas and expertise will directly impact equipment performance, safety standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and grow within a supportive and forward-thinking team, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Ensure equipment reliability by engaging in proactive maintenance and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives (CIP) Promote a safe work environment by applying 6S principles and supporting ABRA safety protocols Collaborate across teams to support modernization, expansion, and smooth operation of production lines Support documentation efforts by contributing to daily task records and developing troubleshooting resources Contribute to system upkeep by helping maintain production planning software (SiView) and updating equipment databases and logs Participate in audits and help address safety-related action items and improvements Support technical operations by assisting with system maintenance and ensuring production aligns with current best practices Your background Technical apprenticeship with subsequent specific extension courses, or degree in electronics, mechanics, or physics, or equivalent education At least 5 years of experience in maintaining semiconductor production systems (preventive measures, troubleshooting, repairs, documentation), especially with production equipment used in photolithography Know-how in tools for resist coating \/ developing (Screen 80B\/80EX) and exposing (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Good command of German and English mandatory, any other language advantageous Willingness to work in shifts Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills More About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.
