descriptions.it: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you! How you'll make an impact Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment Your background Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent) 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems) Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations Good communication skills in English (German is a plus) More about us You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key. Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes. This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes. This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus Approximately 25% Travel required More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all! How you'll make an impact You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Der Bereich High Voltage Products der Hitachi Energy ist weltweit anerkannt als Spezialist für Anlagen der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. Innerhalb des Bereichs High Voltage Products ist der Bereich Hochstromsysteme verantwortlich für Entwicklung, Verkauf, Produktion und den Service von Generatorleistungsschaltern. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung der Montage von PGHV-Produkten gemäss den Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen aus den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen Arbeiten nach Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenaufträgen, technischen Unterlagen, Schemata, Checklisten und Arbeitsplänen Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgelegten QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellenerkennung und -behebung sowie Meldung an den Vorgesetzten Einhaltung des festgelegten Ablaufs zur Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker\/in Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Selbständige, zuverlässige und saubere Arbeitsweise Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden dein Profil ab Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptions.it: The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our dynamic Engineering team in Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, as a Project Manager Engineering and lead technically the execution and tendering of cutting-edge eMobility electric power supply infrastructure projects—including DC charging solutions for electric buses. You'll shape technical solutions, lead engineering efforts across MV & LV distribution systems and power conversion equipment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about sustainable mobility and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Take technical lead in execution and tendering of eMobility electrical infrastructure projects (e.g., bus depots, terminal charging stations), support and guide Local execution and tendering teams Own all engineering activities across project lifecycles—from concept to commissioning Collaborate internally with Local Operating Units responsible for project execution and tendering, Sales, R&D, Product engineers, Supply chain, Site Installation & Commissioning teams and externally with customers, suppliers Coordinate and supervise remote engineering teams for primary and secondary engineering tasks as applicable Design power supply system architectures, perform sizing calculations, and prepare technical specifications Evaluate supplier offers and support procurement processes with Supply Chain Management Provide technical expertise during tendering and project execution phases Translate customer requirements into optimized, compliant technical solutions Lead technical discussions with clients, resolve site queries, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables Ensure safety, compliance, and engineering excellence throughout the project Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on Power Electronics or Power Systems 7–10 years of experience in MV\/LV power distribution systems, electrical systems design & engineering Experience with DC power supply systems, power converters, energy storage, or harmonic filtering is a plus Strong knowledge of engineering tools and software (e.g., BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) Proactive, results-driven mindset with strong teamwork and communication skills Committed to safety, quality, and continuous learning Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer and project meetings Fluent in English and French More about us • We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you driven to create global impact through the leadership of complex, high-value projects? Do you combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities? Within Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Product Group, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our global Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) business, based in Zürich-Oerlikon, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of strategically important projects in a global, matrix organization. You will lead cross-functional teams across regions, act as a key interface to international customers, and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, international projects from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to global customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and factory acceptance tests Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (7+ years) managing complex projects in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives and internal leadership Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, international projects from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to global customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and factory acceptance tests Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (7+ years) managing complex projects in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives and internal leadership Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können. --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d) The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Montagefachkraft in der Produktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Fertigung unserer Produkte. Du richtest Produktionsanlagen ein, führst Montagearbeiten durch und stellst sicher, dass alle Arbeitsschritte gemäss Vorgaben hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Dank deiner Erfahrung erkennst du Abweichungen frühzeitig, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse sowie die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Montage- und Produktionsarbeiten gemäss Spezifikationen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Qualitätsstandards Einrichten, Bedienen und Überwachen von Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsmitteln Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs unter Einhaltung von Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsvorgaben Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie Identifikation, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen Bewegen, Sortieren und Verpacken von Materialien und Fertigprodukten Dokumentation von Produktionsdaten zur Unterstützung der Leistungsanalyse Unterstützung bei der Optimierung von Prozessen sowie Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen Fachliche Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von weniger erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische\/handwerkliche Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung in der Produktion Mehrjährige Erfahrung im industriellen Produktionsumfeld, idealerweise in Montage oder Fertigung Gute Kenntnisse von Produktionsprozessen, Arbeitsabläufen und Werkzeugen Fähigkeit, auch bei komplexeren Problemen strukturiert Lösungen zu erarbeiten Selbstständige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wissen weiterzugeben Bereitschaft in 2-Schicht Betrieb zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie und gestalte unsere Produktion durch datengetriebene Prozessoptimierung aktiv mit. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium – etwa aus Methoden- und Projektmanagement – direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. • Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Automatisiere Geschäftsprozesse mit Power BI, Power Automate oder Power Platform Betreue und begleite sowohl bestehende als auch neue Projekte Arbeite mit Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) und Datenbanken Erstelle Prozessabläufe nach BPMN 2.0 und treibe die Digitalisierung (Process Mining, Citizen Development und Businessanalysen) voran Verbinde technisches Know-how mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken und setze die Theorie in Praxis um (Requirement Engineering) Lerne bei uns wie man verschiedene Anspruchsgruppen abholt um erfolgreich Wirkung zu erzielen (Change Management) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Offenheit, Proaktivität und Selbstmotivation Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B1) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. • Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In this role, you will plan, prepare, and coordinate all pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities through to successful handover. You will develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, manuals, test procedures, and documentation, ensuring all activities meet customer, quality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with engineering, project management, and third‑party partners to resolve technical issues, obtain required approvals, and secure customer acceptance. Working independently, you will apply your technical expertise to drive safe, efficient, and compliant commissioning execution while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the wider project team. How you'll make an impact • Carry out testing and commissioning of control and relay panels and substation automation systems across various locations in Singapore • Execute commissioning activities safely in line with Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards, reporting hazards and near misses • Ensure a positive customer experience and manage customer relationships professionally • Perform commissioning according to documented processes and checklists, resolving open points and securing customer sign‑off • Report site progress and planning and ensure efficient use of commissioning assets such as test kits and tools • Hand over marked‑up drawings for as‑built preparation and final submission to the customer • Identify and monitor risks in your area of responsibility, ensuring stakeholders remain informed • Provide guidance to associate commissioning engineers and coordinate tasks with junior staff or small Your background • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field • Several years of hands‑on experience in commissioning protection, control, or substation automation systems • Solid knowledge of protection relays, substation communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850), and related testing tools • Strong understanding of safety standards and compliance requirements in utility or industrial environments • Experience interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation • Ability to interact confidently with customers, engineers, project managers, and external stakeholders • Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work independently at customer sites More about us At Hitachi Energy, diversity and collaboration are central to how we work. We believe that bringing together different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas strengthens our teams and drives innovation. You will join a global environment where people support each other, learn from one another, and work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptions.it: The opportunity The role involves leading & ensuring the execution of the backlog according to priorities. Candidate will drive design platform process improvements, maintain burnup dashboards, and track agreed programming KPIs. This role requires strong leadership, coordination with R&D, and support for users on technical questions. How you'll make an impact Ensure backlog execution according to priorities. Drive continuous improvements in the design platform process. Maintain burnup dashboards and monitor programming KPIs. Provide effort estimations during the prioritization process. Coordinate with R&D to ensure clear understanding of Technical Specifications (TS). Address users' tickets and escalate issues when necessary. Support users on technical questions and provide guidance. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background ​ 7+years of experience with Masters or Bachelor of Engineering in mechanical design, Information technology. Proven experience in mechanical design and development. Strong understanding of technical specification development and R&D workflows. Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage priorities and drive timely execution. Experience in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and maintain KPIs

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Dry Transformer Engineering team and play a pivotal role in the development of advanced transformer technologies that elevate safety, efficiency, and sustainability across critical power networks. In this position, you will collaborate with cross‑functional partners — including R&D, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain — to translate complex customer requirements into reliable, manufacturable engineering solutions.  How you'll make an impact Conduct structural analysis by hand calculations and finite element simulations on electrical machines for a variety of load cases (e.g. lifting, seismic, short circuit, shock, fatigue etc.) Perform experimental test for the validation of finite element models through comparison with experimental results Conduct experimental testing campaign for the diagnostic of structure-borne and air-borne noise of electrical equipment Ensure that all structural designs complie with relevant industry codes, standards and regulations Prepare detailed structural reports to be delivered to our customers Assist the design engineers in the development of transformer and reactors structural components Support other departments in preparing for customer technical meetings and design reviews Your background Master's degree in mechanical engineering or similar field Proficiency with numerical and analytical calculation software such as ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB Knowledge of relevant building codes (Eurocode) and regulations Experience with noise and vibration measurements and relevant data post-processing Work experience in the transformer industry as well as knowledge of transformer manufacturing process, assembly procedures and best practices is a plus Experience with CAD software such as CREO and Inventor is an advantage Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and written Ability to work effectively both individually and in a team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact Conduct structural analysis by hand calculations and finite element simulations on electrical machines for a variety of load cases (e.g. lifting, seismic, short circuit, shock, fatigue etc.) Perform experimental test for the validation of finite element models through comparison with experimental results Conduct experimental testing campaign for the diagnostic of structure-borne and air-borne noise of electrical equipment Ensure that all structural designs complie with relevant industry codes, standards and regulations Prepare detailed structural reports to be delivered to our customers Assist the design engineers in the development of transformer and reactors structural components Support other departments in preparing for customer technical meetings and design reviews Your background Master's degree in mechanical engineering or similar field Proficiency with numerical and analytical calculation software such as ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB Knowledge of relevant building codes (Eurocode) and regulations Experience with noise and vibration measurements and relevant data post-processing Work experience in the transformer industry as well as knowledge of transformer manufacturing process, assembly procedures and best practices is a plus Experience with CAD software such as CREO and Inventor is an advantage Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and written Ability to work effectively both individually and in a team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione a Zurigo‑Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un progettista di ricerca e sviluppo per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo interruttori nell'ambito dello sviluppo di interruttori automatici ad alta tensione. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alle attività di progettazione e sviluppo del prodotto all'interno del nostro panorama CAD\/PLM per progetti di ricerca e sviluppo in corso. La posizione fa parte del team di sviluppo degli interruttori e lavora a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri responsabili di ricerca e sviluppo nell'ambito dei progetti di sviluppo prodotto. Sarai responsabile della creazione, della manutenzione e della qualità dei dati del modello 3D\/2D per i componenti e gli assiemi assegnati, supportando lo sviluppo del prodotto virtuale dalla fase di prototipo alla produzione in serie. Cerchi sfide tecniche in un ambiente di sviluppo frenetico? Afferra rapidamente argomenti tecnici e ti piace lavorare attraverso diversi punti di vista per raggiungere solide soluzioni tecniche? Ti piace risolvere compiti di progettazione complessi in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti? Allora questa posizione offre l'opportunità giusta per te. Unisciti al nostro team e contribuisci allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta tensione di alta qualità in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Come avrai un impatto Assumerti la responsabilità dell'implementazione 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM, dal concept design alla produzione in serie, nell'ambito di progetti di sviluppo prodotto su dispositivi di commutazione ad alta tensione Creare, modificare e analizzare la progettazione di componenti e assiemi selezionati di dispositivi di commutazione in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri di ricerca e sviluppo e collaborare e supportare altre parti interessate del progetto, come la catena di fornitura e la cura del prodotto Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi e attività relativi a CAD\/PLM\/SAP e promuovere la qualità complessiva del modello Il tuo background Completato con successo apprendistato come Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Eccellente know-how nei sistemi CAD\/PLM, idealmente PTC CREO e PTC Windchill Buona conoscenza di SAP\/Office Elevate aspettative sulla qualità del lavoro sotto tutti gli aspetti Personalità indipendente, proattiva e orientata agli obiettivi Modo di lavorare pratico e orientato alla pratica Giocatore di squadra, impegnato, disposto ad apprendere Buona padronanza del tedesco sia scritto che parlato
descriptions.en: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development. In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD\/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D\/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production. Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich. How you'll make an impact Take responsibility for the 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD\/PLM\/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality Your background Successfully completed apprenticeship as Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent know-how in CAD\/PLM systems, ideally PTC CREO and PTC Windchill Good Knowledge in SAP\/Office High expectations on quality of work in all regards Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality Practically oriented and hands-on way of working Team-player, committed, willing to learn Good command of German both written and spoken
descriptions.de: Die Chance Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte in Zürich-Oerlikon suchen wir einen F&E-Designer zur Verstärkung unseres Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams im Bereich der Entwicklung von Hochspannungs-Leistungsschaltern. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu Produktdesign- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten innerhalb unserer CAD/PLM-Landschaft für laufende F&E-Projekte bei. Die Position ist Teil des Interrupter-Entwicklungsteams und arbeitet im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten eng mit den verantwortlichen F&E-Ingenieuren zusammen. Sie sind für die Erstellung, Pflege und Qualität von 3D-/2D-Modelldaten für zugewiesene Komponenten und Baugruppen verantwortlich und unterstützen die virtuelle Produktentwicklung von der Prototypenphase bis zur Serienproduktion. Suchen Sie technische Herausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen Entwicklungsumgebung? Sie haben ein schnelles Verständnis für technische Themen und haben Spaß daran, durch unterschiedliche Sichtweisen zu robusten technischen Lösungen zu gelangen? Lösen Sie gerne komplexe Konstruktionsaufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren? Dann bietet diese Position genau das Richtige für Sie. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und tragen Sie in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich zur Entwicklung hochwertiger Hochspannungsprodukte bei. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die 3D-/2D-CAD-/PLM-Implementierung vom Konzeptdesign bis zur Serienproduktion im Rahmen von Produktentwicklungsprojekten für Hochspannungsschaltgeräte. Erstellen, modifizieren und analysieren Sie das Design ausgewählter Komponenten und Baugruppen von Schaltgeräten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit F&E-Ingenieuren und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Projektbeteiligten zusammen und unterstützen Sie sie, z. B. Lieferkette und Produktpflege. Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CAD-/PLM-/SAP-bezogenen Prozesse und Aktivitäten bei und fördern Sie die Gesamtmodellqualität. Ihr Hintergrund. Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Hervorragende Kenntnisse in CAD\/PLM-Systemen, idealerweise PTC CREO und PTC Windchill Gute Kenntnisse in SAP\/Office Hoher Anspruch an die Arbeitsqualität in allen Belangen Selbstständige, proaktive und zielorientierte Persönlichkeit Praxisorientierte und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise Teamplayer, engagiert, lernwillig Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Pour notre division Produits haute tension à Zurich‑Oerlikon, nous recherchons un concepteur R&D pour renforcer notre équipe de développement d'interrupteurs dans le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez aux activités de conception et de développement de produits au sein de notre paysage CAO\/PLM pour les projets de R&D en cours. Le poste fait partie de l'équipe de développement d'interrupteurs et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D responsables des projets de développement de produits. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la maintenance et de la qualité des données de modèles 3D\/2D pour les composants et assemblages assignés, prenant en charge le développement de produits virtuels depuis la phase de prototype jusqu'à la production en série. Êtes-vous à la recherche de défis techniques dans un environnement de développement au rythme rapide ? Vous maîtrisez rapidement les sujets techniques et aimez travailler à travers différents points de vue pour parvenir à des solutions techniques robustes ? Aimez-vous résoudre des tâches de conception complexes en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés ? Alors ce poste offre la bonne opportunité pour vous. Rejoignez notre équipe et contribuez au développement de produits haute tension de haute qualité dans un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous aurez un impact Assumer la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre de la CAO\/PLM 3D\/2D, de la conception à la production en série dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits sur des appareils de commutation haute tension. Créer, modifier et analyser la conception de composants et d'assemblages sélectionnés d'appareils de commutation en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs R&D, et collaborer et soutenir les autres parties prenantes du projet, telles que la chaîne d'approvisionnement et l'entretien des produits. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et activités liés à la CAO\/PLM\/SAP et piloter la qualité globale du modèle. Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent savoir-faire en systèmes CAO\/PLM, idéalement PTC CREO et PTC Windchill Bonnes connaissances en SAP\/Office Attentes élevées en matière de qualité de travail à tous égards Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers les objectifs Orientation pratique et méthode de travail pratique Esprit d'équipe, engagé, désireux d'apprendre Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand à l'écrit et à l'oral

descriptions.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Ti piacerebbe realizzare progetti entusiasmanti nel campo dei trasformatori in un team internazionale? Hai esperienza nella gestione di progetti orientata al cliente e ottimizzata in termini di costi e vorresti contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronti a contribuire a plasmare il futuro – idealmente nel sud della Germania? Allora candidati adesso! Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Responsabilità per progetti medio-grandi nel settore dei trasformatori Controllo e monitoraggio dei requisiti del progetto, inclusi programmi, documentazione, ottimizzazioni del progetto, controllo dei costi, obiettivi del progetto e valutazione dei rischi Chiarimento dei dettagli tecnici con i clienti e le parti interessate interne dopo aver ricevuto un ordine Persona di contatto centrale per la comunicazione interna ed esterna del progetto, sia ai clienti che al sito di produzione Garantire il completamento del progetto con successo in conformità con le condizioni contrattuali e le linee guida interne Responsabilità per la gestione dei reclami e dei reclami per ridurre al minimo i potenziali rischi aziendali Il tuo background Studi di ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica o in un settore comparabile Almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi, possibilmente con diversi progetti paralleli Buona conoscenza dei trasformatori, conoscenza della tecnologia dell'alta tensione è un vantaggio Esperienza nella gestione dei sinistri e dei rischi Buona conoscenza del diritto contrattuale Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, il francese è un vantaggio Certificazione di gestione del progetto (ad es. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) è un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere. --- Traduzione in inglese di seguito --- Project Manager commerciale - Trasformatori 80 - 100% (f\/m\/d) L'opportunità Ti piacerebbe realizzare entusiasmanti progetti di trasformatori come parte di un team internazionale? Porti esperienza nella gestione di progetti incentrati sul cliente e ottimizzati in termini di costi e vuoi contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronto a contribuire a plasmare il futuro? Allora candidati adesso! Come avrai un impatto Responsabilità per progetti di medie e grandi dimensioni nel settore dei trasformatori Gestione e monitoraggio dei requisiti del progetto, inclusi programmi, documentazione, ottimizzazioni del progetto, controllo dei costi, obiettivi del progetto e valutazioni dei rischi Chiarimento dei dettagli tecnici con i clienti e le parti interessate interne dopo l'effettuazione dell'ordine Agire come punto di contatto centrale per la comunicazione interna ed esterna del progetto, sia con i clienti che con il sito di produzione Garantire il completamento del progetto con successo in conformità con le condizioni contrattuali e le linee guida interne Gestione dei reclami e dei reclami per prevenire potenziali rischi aziendali Il tuo background Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Meccanica, o in un campo comparabile Almeno 8 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti, idealmente coinvolgendo più progetti paralleli Conoscenza approfondita dei trasformatori, conoscenza della tecnologia dell'alta tensione è un vantaggio Esperienza nella gestione dei sinistri e dei rischi Solida conoscenza del diritto contrattuale Ottima conoscenza di tedesco e inglese, il francese è un vantaggio Certificazione di gestione del progetto (ad es. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) è un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können. --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d) The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de projets orientée client et optimisée en termes de coûts et souhaitez-vous contribuer activement au développement ultérieur d'un environnement dynamique ? Prêt à contribuer à façonner l’avenir – idéalement dans le sud de l’Allemagne ? Alors postulez maintenant ! descriptions.it: La divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione di Hitachi Energy è riconosciuta a livello mondiale come specialista nei sistemi di trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. All'interno della divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione, la divisione Sistemi ad alta tensione è responsabile per lo sviluppo, le vendite, la produzione e il servizio degli interruttori a circuito generatore. È possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo effettuando l'assemblaggio dei prodotti PGHV in conformità con le specifiche e gli obiettivi delle procedure di garanzia della qualità e delle istruzioni di lavoro Lavorare secondo documenti di lavoro come ordini del cliente, documenti tecnici, schemi, liste di controllo e orari di lavoro Montaggio tempestivo ed economico delle assemblee e dei sistemi di commutazione Rispetto al rilevamento e correzione delle linee guida QS definite, nonché la notifica al supervisore Compliance con il processo definito per la risoluzione dei problemi Questo ti porta con completato l'apprendistato professionale come un'esperienza polimeccanica / / in esperienza pratica e teorica nell'assemblaggio di macchine Buona conoscenza nel parlare e nella scrittura Buona conoscenza nella lettura dei documenti di disegno e dei documenti di lavoro Autolavoro, affidabile e pulito metodi di lavoro Responsabilità- e qualità-cosciente personalità Flessibilità, resistenza e determinazione arrotondare il tuo profilo Maggiori informazioni su di noi Hitachi Energy sta per tecnologie innovative e soluzioni energetiche sostenibili in tutto il mondo. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un posto di lavoro sicuro in una società orientata al futuro, emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e apprezzativo e benefici sociali attraenti.
descriptions.en: The High Voltage Products division of Hitachi Energy is recognized worldwide as a specialist in power transmission and distribution systems. Within the High Voltage Products division, the High Voltage Systems division is responsible for the development, sales, production and service of generator circuit breakers. You can achieve this by carrying out the assembly of PGHV products in accordance with the specifications and objectives from the quality assurance procedures and work instructions Work according to working papers such as customer orders, technical documents, schemes, checklists and work schedules Timely and economical assembly of the assemblies and switch systems Compliance with the defined QS guidelines vulnerability detection and correction as well as notification to the supervisor Compliance with the defined process for troubleshooting This brings you with completed vocational apprenticeship as a polymechanic / / into practical and theoretical experience in machine assembly Good knowledge in speaking and writing Good knowledge in reading drawing documents and working papers Self-employed, reliable and clean working methods Responsibility- and quality-conscious personality Flexibility, endurance and determination round off your profile More about us Hitachi Energy stands for innovative technologies and sustainable energy solutions worldwide. With us, you can expect a secure workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and appreciative working environment and attractive social benefits.
descriptions.de: Über die Position Der Bereich High Voltage Products der Hitachi Energy ist weltweit anerkannt als Spezialist für Anlagen der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. Innerhalb des Bereichs High Voltage Products ist der Bereich Hochstromsysteme verantwortlich für Entwicklung, Verkauf, Produktion und den Service von Generatorleistungsschaltern. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung der Montage von PGHV-Produkten gemäss den Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen aus den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen Arbeiten nach Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenaufträgen, technischen Unterlagen, Schemata, Checklisten und Arbeitsplänen Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgelegten QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellenerkennung und -behebung sowie Meldung an den Vorgesetzten Einhaltung des festgelegten Ablaufs zur Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker\/in Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Selbständige, zuverlässige und saubere Arbeitsweise Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden dein Profil ab Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.
descriptions.fr: La division des produits haute tension de Hitachi Energy est reconnue mondialement comme spécialiste des systèmes de transmission et de distribution d'électricité. Au sein de la division Produits haute tension, la division Systèmes haute tension est responsable du développement, de la vente, de la production et du service des disjoncteurs générateurs. Vous pouvez y parvenir en effectuant l'assemblage de produits PGHV conformément aux spécifications et objectifs des procédures d'assurance de la qualité et des instructions de travail Travaillez selon des documents de travail tels que les commandes des clients, les documents techniques, les schémas, les listes de contrôle et les horaires de travail Montage rapide et économique des assemblages et des systèmes d'interrupteurs Conformité aux lignes directrices QS définies Détection et correction de vulnérabilité ainsi que notification au superviseur Conformité au processus défini pour le dépannage Cela vous amène avec l'apprentissage professionnel complété comme polymécanique / / dans l'expérience pratique et théorique en montage de machine Bonne connaissance de la parole et de l'écriture Bonne connaissance de la lecture des documents de dessin et des documents de travail Travailleur indépendant, fiable et propre Personnalité responsable et de qualité Flexibilité, endurance et détermination complètent votre profil En savoir plus sur nous Hitachi Énergie représente des technologies innovantes et des solutions énergétiques durables dans le monde entier. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un lieu de travail sûr dans une entreprise orientée vers l'avenir, des possibilités de développement passionnantes, un environnement de travail collégial et appréciateur et des avantages sociaux attrayants.
